Land marked by our towering 10-ft bowling pin, The Gutter features a one-lane bowling alley open daily for spontaneous games, wild strikes, and the occasional gutterball. Spin your way into The Spare Room, a shaded lounge and dance space, a bowling-themed bar, and a DJ booth spinning beats to keep the energy rolling. Whether you're here to strike, dance, or just chill, The Gutter is the perfect place to let the good times roll - and don't forget to ask us about our PinPal VIP program!

camps.name: The Hand Lovers Lounge
camps.description: A soft landing space for hands, lovers, lovers of hands, and everything in between!

camps.name: The Hash House
camps.description:
Formerly BRCH3, slings the greasy delicious carb-loaded potatos that we all know and love and much much more all served by members of The Hash House Harriers, the (in)famous drinking club with a running problem since 1938. Grab some spuds and spice them up with your hot sauce of choice from the hot sauce library. Enjoy a cold drink or a drinking challenge at our moderately well stocked bar. Tune up or fix your bike at our DIY bike repair station. Challenge your liver, legs, and tastebuds in the Malort Mile. And make sure to join us on Thursday in your red dress (don't worry we'll have some for you at our boutique) for our annual Red Dress Ride for a tour of some of playas best and worse bars with a few hundred other half minds.

ON ON!

camps.name: The Institute
camps.description: The Institute of higher yearning invites the dusty wanderer to expand their mind into the bottomless pit of knowledge and exploration.

camps.name: The Island
camps.description: A French-speaking camp sharing the spirit of Polynesia at Burning Man. Come discover a warm and relaxing space inspired by Tahiti, with traditional monoï oil massages, cultural touches, and an inviting island atmosphere

camps.name: The Key Camp
camps.description:
The Key = Believe. We have a key for you to open any door. During our interactive event, "Fortune Key Hunting," we will help you discover your key and guide you on how to use it to open new doors in life.

After you explore your key, we will serve cold Japanese green tea and offer you a choice of a henna tattoo of your Kanji or a Kanji sticker.

camps.name: The Last Starfighters
camps.description: Greetings, Starfighter. You have been recruited by the Star League to defend the playa against commodification & moop. Your participation in supporting artists by building a branch of The Solar Library & giving home to Solarians is to be commended. Your communal effort & civic responsibility will be known across the galaxy. You as a radically self reliant creature have always wanted to fight a desperate battle against incredibly dusty odds. The Trailing Soul & Augmented Reality Porta Potties are your legacy. Remember to listen next time a gung-ho iguana tells you to relax.

camps.name: The Lavender Lounge
camps.description: Welcome to The Lavender Lounge! Come in out of the sun and receive a relaxing scalp massage while we mist you with lavender scented water. Lie back on an air mattress and take a few moments to slow down and enjoy yourself. You will leave feeling fresh, alive, and with just a bit more pep in your step! Open 11am-2pm Mon-Fri

camps.name: The Lost Penguins
camps.description:
We have been a hospitality camp on playa since 2001. We are returning this year to bring you our amazing brain-freezing snow cones, and sizzling hot entertainment! Stop by and take shelter from the hot sun, or sit out a dust storm, in our welcoming 40' x 80' shaded lounge. You can relax on our comfy couches, while you enjoy your snow cone or cold beverage from the bar. 

We have live and DJ music, as well as open mic. Feel free to strike up a conversation with someone new, or simply people watch. For age 21+ patrons, you may enjoy our famous Penguin Pee (lemonade & vodka), regular lemonade, or cold water. Enjoy tasty red & black licorice during the day, and decadent dark chocolate at night. We cannot wait to welcome you to our waddle!

camps.name: The Makers Space
camps.description: We are an art support camp and would love to offer support to the artists and builders on playa. with help, food, drinks, materials, other resources if needed.

camps.name: The Market
camps.description: Imagine you are wandering through Playa on your way home from a night of adventure or just starting out in search of adventure. Your stomach growls a bit, maybe you feel just a tiny bit thirsty. From afar you see a gathering of carts, lit up and welcoming. What's going on over there? You pedal towards it and stumble upon The Market. You are suddenly surrounded with stands offering their goods. You eat, you drink, and maybe you even get your future told. Get a new jacket! Get hustled in a strangely rigged dice game. You can't help but think - is this the start of your night, or the center of it all?

camps.name: The Melon Motel
camps.description: A retro desert oasis where playful hospitality meets music and connection. Step into our motel-inspired world, check in with our crew, and become part of the experience. By day, we host a vibrant shaded lounge serving refreshing melon-based drinks and creating a social space to relax, meet new people, and recharge. Throughout the week, we also offer wellness sessions including yoga and movement under our central shade structure. By night, The Melon Motel transforms into a high-energy destination with curated music, immersive lighting, and a dancefloor that brings people together. Whether you're stopping by to cool off, connect, or get lost in the music, The Melon Motel is always open for a good time.

camps.name: The Mystical Grill
camps.description: A global circle of kindred spirits united by fire, flavor, and story. We gift two styles of traditional Argentinian Asado from our open grill and invite Burners to gather for communal meals, spontaneous storytelling, readings from our camp tarot reader, and soul warming connection. We honor food as a ritual, fire as transformation, and the Playa as our shared home.

camps.name: The OG Pit
camps.description:
The OG PIT is a little fire, a little fancy, a little filthy—but always family. We build hard, stay late, and never forget why we're here. Whether you're sipping morning mimosa coffee, slapping your way through a late-night meltdown, or screaming karaoke to the stars, you're always welcome in The Pit!
See you in the dust, baby.

camps.name: The Organization
camps.description: Whether you are tired and in need of energy, or simply heading out on the playa and in need of a drink, stop by our camp for an espresso martini (or simply an iced coffee or non-alcoholic beverage)! Meet and chat with fellow burners while you sit in our shade, lay down in our hammock, rest in our cuddle puddle or jump on our trampoline.

camps.name: The Parlour Room
camps.description: The Parlour Room is a classy-not-classy, heavily shady/shaded, industrial Victorian lounge space welcoming all BRC citizens to come relax under the shade with a cool beverage during the morning and afternoon or chat the night's adventures fantastic around our fire pit in the wee hours.

camps.name: The Pearly Gate
camps.hometown: Boise, New York, California, Seattle, Ukraine
camps.description: Your one-stop shop for the afterlife. Come find your way through your sins and salvations, walk our runway, bring out your inner Sexy Jesus and Foxy Mary, come to our fetish ball or just stop by for a drink.

camps.name: The Pink Spot
camps.description: The Pink Spot is an art car support camp with The Big Bunny art car, Dj driven holding up to 40 burners. We will leave camp every evening around dusk, please come by for a prefunk and hop on for a thorough throw down!

camps.name: The Pleasure Dairy
camps.description: Finally, what you've been waiting for! A Burning Man Camp that reimagines the little-known historic phenomenon of pleasure dairies! Think Marie Antoinette but in the Wild West. A place where you can never have too many cows or cow puns. At high noon be udderly refreshed by dairy-alternative craft cocktails at our bar, The Tits, and spend some time in the shade nourishing your connections at our message-in-a-bottle service. After sundown, explore our LED cactus garden and kick up your boots in our cozy lounge. Moo-la-la!

camps.name: The Shittest Camp
camps.description:
Our camp celebrates one of the most universal human experiences: poop. Through humor, art, and playful activities, we aim to normalize conversations around bodily functions and remind everyone that we all share the same basic human needs.

Our camp features a toilet-themed bar, a quirky camp museum, and a variety of interactive activities including DJ sets, comedy, scavenger hunts, and creative workshops. Everything is centered around bathroom humor and lighthearted fun.

We welcome everyone to stop by, laugh with us, and participate in the wonderfully ridiculous side of being human.

camps.name: The Shrimp Ranch
camps.description:
Howdy! Welcome to the Shrimp Ranch, where the Wild West meets the salty sea. We're a camp of new and seasoned looking to create a unique experience for the community in the only way we know how: through quirky food, music and event offerings. 

Our ragtag crew will transport you to an imagined past, where crustaceans roamed the frontier. Come learn the lore and embrace our culture at the famous Shrimp Ranch Rodeo! From shrimp snacks and shrimp brine martinis, to our Shrimp Yoga and Crabbin' Shack, get ready to live your nautical fantasy and somehow leave weirdly warmer (or cooler) than you came.

camps.name: The Shuttle Home
camps.description:
A welcoming tea lounge and connection space offering a calm refuge within Black Rock City. Centered around a shaded Tea Lounge, we host tea ceremonies, consent workshops, guided conversations, and intimate gatherings designed to encourage meaningful connection.

Our camp invites participants to slow down, share stories, and recharge in a warm and inclusive environment. With comfortable seating, soft lighting, and a relaxed atmosphere, The Shuttle Home serves as a grounding point for those seeking presence, reflection, and authentic human interaction.

Come by for tea, stay for connection, and leave feeling restored.

camps.name: The Society of Supreme Excellence
camps.description: The Society (for the Pursuit) of Supreme Excellence cordially invites you to pursue excellence in all facets of existence. We're here to support your journey towards pursuing excellence through a variety of excellent activities, including revitalising elixirs, nourishing pizza & supremely soul soothing bass.

camps.name: The Sound Garden
camps.description: We are a high vibe sound camp here to delight your senses with a unique 360 degree sound system that will blow your mind. By night we bring you some of the most talented DJ's and artists to create an unforgettable experience of movement, sound and performance. By day we host sound healings, deep house yoga, and listening parties of your favorite artists. We also offer body work, and a few healing workshops in our Garden Lounges

camps.name: The Sultry Lodge
camps.description:
A sultry crowd from 3 continents!

# A stunning UV-Black-Light Interactive-Art Exhibition:
from Dusk till Dawn.

# Lounge & Chill in Gentle Shade:
through Sultry Day till Fading Eventide.

# Get your hair Braided with colorful extensions:
Mon & Tue noon.
(** volunteer braiding helpers needed! **)

# Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea:
Wed late morning.

# Make your own jewelry out of colorful beads:
Weekdays daytime.

# Birthday Party for every Birthday Star on the Playa:
Thursday after sunset

camps.name: The Surge
camps.description: Come charge your small devices at THE SURGE's bar or living room. Join us for cold-brew coffee, morning meditation, education, conversation in our comfortable living room with a water mister, or grab a tasty brew or shot (or NA cocktail) at our fabulous bar. Join us for our Cancer Survivor circle on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 11am. Come to our workshop How to become Solar Powered on Wednesday at noon. Come meditate with us at 10 am.

camps.name: THE VEIL
camps.description: Empyrean is an immersive, walk-through theatrical experience that invites you into a mystical journey of beauty, darkness, and transformation. Step inside our atmospheric realms where living art, interactive spirit guides, and cinematic staging surround you in a story you don't just watch, you walk through. When you emerge, drift into our luminous lounge, a sanctuary to reflect, unravel, and process the experience in beauty and connection.

camps.name: The Wastelanders
camps.description: Forged from scavenged tech, glowing mesh, and post industrial grit, this camp pulses with creative chaos.. By day, rogue artists, builders, and hackers gather for connection and playful acts of radical self-expression. By night, the Fire Zone comes alive with performances from local and visiting fire artists. Inside the Tech Noir Bar, wanderers trade stories over chilled drinks in a haze of neon and light. A convergence point for makers, performers, and resilient nomads keeping creativity alive.

camps.name: THICC VIBEZ
camps.description: We will have a branch from the giving tree art car that we have not used on the at car for sometime now. We will be mounting this 8' long horizontally arched branch 15' high off one of our frontage street corners, with 12' long GREEN vines hanging from the branch blowing in the wind like a flag. It looks just like the art car so people will know what camp we are when the art car is away from camp.

camps.name: This Is It
camps.description: This is a camp serving hot & iced tea with offerings of a phone charging station and ASL conversation.

camps.name: Three of Cups
camps.description: Cmon down to the tarot swamp to get swampy and get tarot'd.

camps.name: Through the Looking Gl.ass
camps.description: Ever wondered what it's like inside a colon? Now's your chance. Through the Looking Gl.ass is an immersive, walk-through colon exhibit that takes you on a journey through the human digestive tract - complete with glowing lights, and gurgling sounds. Step inside, walk through, and come out the other end with a new perspective on your gut health. Outside the exhibit, leave a message on our community Gut Feelings wall, take a screening pledge, and grab some cheeky swag. Open 10am to late night all week. No appointment necessary - just walk right in. We promise it won't hurt.

camps.name: tiny camp
camps.description: tiny camp is tiny

camps.name: Titanic
camps.description: Titanic's End is taking a year off, and instead, we are building a giant art activation in the Playa. Look for a giant ship where we will host many events. You can also find our builders at camp and with our HUB camps, Bangers Only and Mothership

camps.name: Titicaca
camps.description: Come and join us on the mystical shores of the exotic Lake Titicaca and enjoy our mountain hospitality.

camps.name: Tossed and Sauced
camps.description: Tossed and Sauced -- a few tossers and some fun-loving saucers are making pizza. We will have pizza on three scheduled days and a couple of pop-up parties. Bring good vibes and a napkin.

camps.name: TOT
camps.description: Where people are nice, the swing set is big and where you are welcome.

camps.name: Totally 80s Disco Aerobic Inferno
camps.description:
Welcome to your one-stop shop for fitness on the playa!

Our camp will be offering a variety of fun and interesting classes throughout the week at different times. So whether you’re a morning, midday, or evening fitness person, we’ve got you.

We’ll have Pilates, dance classes, themed workouts, and plenty of opportunities to move your body. Come by, shake some ass, and leave feeling good.

We’ll also have open gym throughout the week, plus a nighttime decompression area—aka the Calm Down Corner—filled with plushies, neon lights, and a cozy place to relax.

Hope to see you there!

camps.name: Touch Glass
camps.description: Art support camp creating the 2026 Honoraria piece Kaleidoscope.

camps.name: Tour de Chance
camps.description: Êtes-vous chanceux? Ride the the Playa's largest French-themed bicycle-powered carnival game for marvelous prizes! But vélo beware, some are risqué.

camps.name: TOWER69
camps.description: A supportive camp for TOWER69 Mutant Vehicle. Hop on board! While we are on duty, you will not drown in the desert of loneliness!

camps.name: Toxic Disco Clam
camps.description: In the default world, the Toxic Disco Clam is a real aquatic creature. It uses its luminous lips to attract passing fish... and then it dazes them with acidic snot. We're pretty much the same: we draw you in with dazzling lights and entertaining activities, we ply you with our intoxicating beverages, and we hope you never leave.

camps.name: TRANSCEND
camps.description: A place to celebrate the sound of electronic music in all of its forms, a place to "TRANCSEND" mind, body and soul using any beat per minute you can imagine. Join us for this musical journey on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons!

camps.name: Treble Makers
camps.description:
Long day on playa? With a daily wine, music, and cheese pairing at sunset, you'll be able to enjoy some of life's most indulgent pleasures. Our artists are grass-fed, our red wine is selected and served by beret-wearing french busboys, and we will show you the difference between cheese and fu**ng fromage.

If you want to get to the next level of indulgence come enjoy the somatic gyrations delivered to your weary core by the one-and-only Buffer Bush. Swing on by and we will help you hit that higher note, we got your back!

camps.name: Tree of Love
camps.description: Step into a legendary oasis where ancient strength meets modern rhythm. Our camp welcomes all weary travelers to find shade under our monumental tree and dance in the shadow of heroic man and woman warrior statues. Whether you're looking to catch a high-energy sunset DJ set, admire the prototypes of our open-playa art, or simply cool down with a refreshing drink, we offer a cornerstone of community and creativity. Join us at the corner of the block to recharge your spirit and move your dusty feet. We can't wait to dance with you!

camps.name: Turbaza Chayka
camps.description: A playful, interactive camp blending vintage aesthetics with irreverent curiosity. Visitors can sip a fine selection of teas while browsing our vintage porn salon, send handwritten postcards through our Post Office of Questionable Taste, and collect stamps or temporary tattoos from the Department of Dubious Markings. Our Badge Bureau issues official credentials for deeply unofficial activities. For those seeking spectacle, the Ice Bucket Fishing Contest offers a lively, crowd friendly experience. In the evenings, our electric bike bar becomes a glowing gathering point with music, light, and connection. Part archive, part experiment, and part social space, the camp invites participation, humor, and shared moments on playa.

camps.name: Twats Your Gender?
camps.description:
An LGBTQ led camp inviting participants to explore creativity, identity, and connection through playful interactive experiences. 

Visitors can screen print personal items with the address of something meaningful and unique to this year's theme. Guests can also create whimsical insect artwork by stamping marbled paint from their bum to create wings onto a small canvas and adding bug bodies and details to design a one of a kind creature. Art can be taken home or left to dry in our gallery and collected later. 

Our intentionally provocative camp name is meant to spark conversation. Through humor, creativity, and participation we hope to encourage curiosity, foster understanding, and celebrate the radical inclusion that makes our community so powerful.

camps.name: Twilight language
camps.description: A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences. Or maybe it's just the world's best pizza party...

camps.name: Twisted
camps.description: A vibrant gathering space where creativity, connection, and community come to life. Our camp features a welcoming bar with mixologists (you never know what drink concoction we might have!), a cozy coffee station, and a lively atmosphere with music by DJ Tokenoshi and live acoustic jam sessions. Expect a mix of interactive experiences, social spaces, and spontaneous fun. Our setup includes a well-lit cantina-style gathering hub, plush seating, bike racks, and unique art installations. No matter where we land on the playa, we are here to bring good vibes, great conversations, and unforgettable moments. Follow the twisted lights and join the fun.

camps.name: Twisted Swan Celtic pub
camps.description: The Twisted Swan and Bacchus! Come for a calm cool after noon or a nice cold pint at night.

camps.name: Two Lanterns
camps.description: Best weddings on the playa, with all the trimmings! Department of Wedding Planning is in our camp, consult with the experts.

camps.name: U.F.O.
camps.description: U.F.O. is an oasis by day to pamper yourself and relax in a cozy, shaded environment with great music. At night we turn up the bass and the fire. Lots of personality

camps.name: Udder Nonsense
camps.description: Something mysterious has appeared on the playa. A herd of cows, extraterrestrial, or possibly escaped from Fly Ranch, has set up camp, and they want you. Come climb the Milk Tower for panoramic playa views, race mini cow RC cars through our obstacle course, or slip on a pair of cow headphones and lose yourself in the Moo Lounge Rouge silent discow experience. Three times this week we throw our signature Happy Hour Cow Parties: milk-themed drinks, costumed servers, and a cowbell that rings every time someone orders non-dairy. By day look for the giant cow-print dome. By night, follow the glowing cow windsock in the sky. It's a cowspiracy. Have you herd? Come find out.

camps.name: Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves
camps.description:
The Finest Flesh Market in Black Rock City! 

In addition to the Ten Principles, our guiding inspiration is hospitality. We are always honored to serve our guests, even while subjecting them to cruel humiliation, voluntary servitude, and wanton drunkenness. Our gorgeous Moroccan tent is lushly furnished with wall-to-wall rugs, benches, and more pillows than you can count. Ours is a hard-working group of camp mates who come together to create a Moroccan oasis in Black Rock City. Auctions always Tuesday through Thursday at 2pm!

camps.name: Uncle Larry's Misguided Burners
camps.description: Home of KART Radio on 88.3FM! Listen to live music while getting weird on the streets of BRC!

camps.name: Under the Big Top
camps.description: Come visit our camp and enjoy talks and teachings of Qigong energy healing and various other modalities. Relax on the many couches in our chill space with introspective music in the background and fall into some fun and deep conversation about qigong and the meaning of life. Try out some of the dozens of hammocks hanging from an intricate and interesting hammock structure. In the mornings stop by for some yoga in the shade!

camps.name: Unicorner
camps.description:
A family-friendly haven for creativity, light-hearted fun, sharing, and magic! Come lounge in our stuffy pile and color in the UniDome and get a prescription at the Unicorn Advice Booth interactive installation!
Unicorner is created by a crew of hearty shenaniganists who have several goals on the playa: having lots of FUN, spreading lots of LOVE, and championing the 10 Principles of Burning Man in the most positive and supportive manner possible. We host daily activities of all sorts at the Unicorner (many of which are kid- and family-friendly) and encourage art, music, radical self-expression, and community!

camps.name: Unitopia
camps.description: A welcoming oasis of music, creativity, and connection. Our camp features a large shaded lounge where participants can relax, meet new friends, and enjoy playful daytime gatherings. Throughout the week we host morning yoga, coffee and music sessions, workshops, and our signature Unicorns and Spritz dance party. Our music art car SoGnarwhal occasionally docks at camp for special performances with DJs and cirque acts, bringing energy and celebration to our stage and dance floor. Whether you come for music, conversation, or a moment of rest, Unitopia invites you to step inside, share the space, and experience a little magic in the dust.

camps.name: UniverseCity
camps.description: Welcome to UniverseCity, the prestigious Black Rock City College of Arts and Sciences. Our accredited program issues diplomas on any subject matter, however imaginary. These range from the fictional and unlikely to major changes in life direction. Join us on campus and register at the Admissions Office to receive your Letter of Acceptance. Early in the week, attend New Student Orientation activities. Any day, come relax in our verdant Quad, take in lectures of questionable accuracy, gaze into our night time Planetarium. Later in the week we grant diplomas recognizing unique contributions to your field of study during a personalized graduation ceremony. We are a family-friendly camp, welcome all burners to our campus and encourage participation in launching your self-declared education.

camps.name: UnStable
camps.description:
We are a Mutant vehicle Support Camp for an MV named "Chester."
We will be sharing resources and supporting an art support camp called, "Apotheneum." They are a large scale interactive light and sound installation.

camps.name: Vagabonds & Tagalongs
camps.description: A camp for wanderers and wanderlust! Vags and Tags brings together an ever-expanding nationwide community of burners to co-create a space where everyone can feel at home. Come by and see for yourself why we've won the official BRC award for best friends on playa since 2012!

camps.name: Vamp Camp
camps.description: Burning since 1994, one of the oldest camps on playa. We are mostly Battle Born burners whom take pride in Nevada. We enjoy playa lore while sipping our signature Vamp Juice or a cup of joe. Stop by, we do bite!

camps.name: Vault 21+
camps.description:
Vault 21+ invites you to step into our 23-hour-a-day dive bar?that's right, 23 hours. If you're roaming the wasteland and thirsting for a drink, there's a good chance we're open? unless it's sunrise. In that case, take a moment to soak in the irradiated sunrise, then return when the time is right. We'll still be here, with a cold drink waiting for you.

This week, we've got a killer lineup of events, including Karaoke (for those brave enough to sing), themed parties (brace yourself for chaos), and food giveaways (because who doesn't love free rations?). Stop by, grab a drink, cool off in the heat, and kick back. All these activities come with a soundscape of non-stop, certified, vault-approved tunes to set the mood.

We can't wait to welcome your dusty, smiling faces into our vault.

camps.name: VCamp - Vibrations in the Desert
camps.description: A unique sound immersion experience designed to relax, ground, and awaken the senses. Our Vibration Lounge features specially designed vibration platforms equipped with built-in subwoofers that emit deep, resonant frequencies, creating full-body vibrations that promote mindfulness and presence. Visitors are invited to pause, tune in, and journey through curated soundscapes that inspire relaxation, clarity, and connection. Step into our space, close your eyes, and let the vibrations carry you to a place of inner balance.

camps.name: Venice Red Light
camps.description: A roaming tribe of artists, musicians, and delightful weirdos building a playground of sound, art, and human connection. From deep sonic journeys in our dome to unexpected encounters in our lounge, we create a space where strangers become friends (or lovers) and nights stretch into sunrise.

camps.name: Very Inappropriate People
camps.description:
A majority Las Vegas based camp with running daytime saloon events & nightly live music & DJ produced dance events.
Upon entrance you might be surprised with special pop-up performances, Vegas style casino games & inappropriate mobsters trying to swindle you into a deal.
Also known for famous shenanigans such as VIP bottle service surprise, Deer in headlights are art car stalking and many more

camps.name: Vibe Check
camps.description: Vibe Check is an oasis on the playa, here to welcome you in with a cold drink and a shady place to take a load off. Pull up for a drink at our swing bar or relax in a hammock while meeting new friends and enjoying good music.

camps.name: Videogasm
camps.description: Black Rock City's Playa Theater since 1998! Nightly video screenings on our 20' screen. Get your morning coffee at our Slurping Sloth Cafe. Body painting every afternoon in our shade structure. Play with our oversized games. Check out the Sleepy Pickle Bar for one of our daily themed happy hours. You Pick it Double Feature chosen by the citizens of BRC (come by and cast your vote.) Compete in one of our live Game/Talent Shows or walk our red carpet and talk to fellow filmmakers and content creators. Chill out on a hammock or battle it out as Kong or Godzilla in our Hollow Earth Mini-Dome. Home of The Black Rock City Film Festival. Live Rocky Horror Picture Show on Friday night! Contact us to show your original film on our twenty foot screen.

camps.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience
camps.description: VICE is an all inclusive, lgbtq-centric Burning Man Theme Camp returning for the 24th consecutive year to offer cool icy beverages during the heat of the day as well as several other activities for our fellow participants. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walks of life.

camps.name: Vin Et Gare
camps.description:
A queer aperitivo camp built around small offerings and shared moments.

A shaded lounge by day with tastings, drinks, and conversation. A gathering place by evening where identity, attraction, and curiosity blur together.

At night, look for us deep in the playa, where a table appears where it should not be, and a drink is waiting.

camps.name: Vines Without Borders
camps.description: A chill international wine bar and lounge open afternoons and evening daily, gifting great chilled wines and snacks from around the world, served by people from around the world. We celebrate a different wine producing region daily. Great music, fun people, curated tastings and something new every day.

camps.name: Vitruvian
camps.description: Turn your world upside down at Vitruvian Lounge. Enjoy good gyrations by taking a spin on our Human Sized Gyroscope, and stay to enjoy good vibrations in our lounge with great music and ice cold craft cocktails. Head into the K-Box for Korean-style private room karaoke to sing the night away together from 9pm to sunrise.

camps.name: Vivarium
camps.description: Step into a playful, welcoming front porch living room where conversation, comfort, and curiosity come first. Expect a mix of sensory delights, language lessons, music jams, whiskey and bad advice, and late-night grilled cheese hospitality. This is a camp for lingering, laughing, learning something unexpected, and connecting with strangers who may not stay strangers for long. Whether you stop in for a workshop or just need a soft place to land, you are welcome here.

camps.name: Vomiting Sparrows
camps.description: We serve the best Bloody Mary on the playa. We entertain, we make friends, we make fun, we welcome all. Keep an eye and ear open for our special events. Chirp Chirp Blarf!

camps.name: VW Bus Camp
camps.description: You are heartily invited to camp and participate with VW Bus Camp for Axis Mundi arriving on the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper. VW Bus Camp is a wonderful and enduring Burning Man theme camp which has been placed and participated on the Playa every Burn since 1998. First, make sure to change out your leaky fuel lines, check your tires, carry a fire extinguisher and pack lots and lots of spare parts and join us participating in Bus Camp's many interactive projects. Yes, we still have a tie dye party amongst other cool stuff. This is a wonderful opportunity for you to bring out your own projects to share and to teach us all something new. Welcome Home and see you in the dust!

camps.name: Waffles & House
camps.description: We serve up delicious Waffles, with all your favorite toppings, ice cold drinks, and bumping House music for your dancing pleasure all week long! Don't forget to come by on Friday for a syrup licking good time, as that's when we host our world-famous Waffolympics!

camps.name: Wally's Cowboy Kitchen
camps.description: Interactive cooking camp for people to learn camp cooking and have a hot meal. Great place to hang out.

camps.name: Wanderlust
camps.description: Welcome to our Moroccan Themed Oasis in the Desert. Come join us for our fun activities. We look forward to seeing you on the Playa!!!

camps.name: Wasted Sunshine
camps.description: Frozen Lemonade FOR ALL AGES! Fantastic insults! Booze for consenting adults. AC Lounge chill zone.

camps.name: Water Suckers
camps.description: A welcoming bar and lounge camp with music, dancing, and a shaded space to gather on the playa. Our core interactivity is an open portrait and live sketch experience for the Black Rock City community, where passersby can sit for a quick portrait, share a story, strike a pose, or co-create a moment through drawing. Add a small story, poem, gesture, prompt, or playful offering to the exchange.

camps.name: Water Temple
camps.description:
Welcome to Water Temple a sanctuary of serenity, connection, and renewal in the heart of the playa. We're a theme camp dedicated to holding space for hydration, healing, and human connection through elemental experiences and desert hospitality.

At Water Temple, you'll find:
Cold, Kombucha (because hydration is sacred)
Guided meditations & sound baths
Shade, chill zones, and high-pressure misting
Yoga & gentle stretching sessions
Water Temple Speaks- Speaker Series 

We believe in sacred stillness, playful presence, and radical kindness. Whether you're seeking a soft reset or a moment of peace under the dusty sky, our temple doors are open to you.

camps.name: Waterworks
camps.description: A part of Burning Man's Department of Public Works, the Waterworks team manages the Civic Water Program. This includes the delivery logistics of large water deliveries on playa to infrastructure, honorarium art, and theme camps with interactive water usage.  Our office can be found on Esplanade at 5:20 between HEaT and Moop Map HQ.

camps.name: Way Way SuperGood
camps.description: If you've ever been crowned the international skee-ball champion of the entire universe two weeks in a row; If you've ever meant to ride off into the sunset on a hobby horse but got sidetracked fluffing pillows (Cajun Style) at a two-star hotel for decades during your search for your life's true destiny; If you've ever gotten so lost in a really good book that you forgot you can't read because you've been too busy calling all the shots; If you think you would like to know what it's like to fly through the air much the way a brick doesn't or even if you've said it before and you'll say it again before and you'll say it before and you'll say it again again... Stop it, Homegirl! You're trying to do too much. Come have a drink and dance with us instead. It's gonna be a Way Way SuperGood time

camps.name: We < 3 CamPINK!
camps.description: Join in our Family Reunion! We have large yard games for day and night play, Dj sets and our signature CamPINK! Karaoke after dark. Drop by our fabulously monochrome camp and tell us how PINK it is while you play tic-tac-toe, connect4, LED bocce, cornhole or glow Jenga. Or have a fancy cocktail while lounging in a shaded hammock enjoying our hospitality and PINKness. Everyone's a WINNER at CamPINK! Spin the recycle-regifty bin and take home a pink prize, or leave a suitable pink thing for the next playa player. Really feeling the moment, need more PINK in your life? Check out our thread rack to see if there's some new PINK fit waiting for you. We're all FAMILY at HOME on the Playa and everyone is PINK on the inside, right? Come join our Family Reunion in the Dust!

camps.name: Weird Steel
camps.description: A dynamic Burning Man camp where steel artistry takes center stage. We are a collective of passionate artists and creators dedicated to pushing the boundaries of creativity through the medium of steel and steel-framed art installations. From Rhino Redemption, Medusa, and The Flower Tower, Fire Cathedral, Brass Ring just to name a few. Our camp is a celebration of innovation, imagination, and the transformative power of art.

camps.name: Westlandia
camps.description: We are a home to Abu the Horsefly, an art car inspired by Studio Ghibli animated movies. Abu bridges the worlds of humans and nature, and teaches us that only together we can make a difference.

camps.name: Wetspot
camps.description: Established in 2010 and based in Reno, NV, Wetspot is a playa favorite saloon for daytime fun and libations. We invite you to come kick in our doors and let us fill your cup with an ice-cold draft beer or our legendary Skip-and-Go Naked cocktail. Feeling like your burn needs a little more, burn? We've got you covered with a shot of our spicy tequila. You just might end up on the Wall of Flame! Drinking not your thing? That's okay too! Wetspot is about making new friends in an open-to-all setting. Dancing and laughter are guaranteed. Cheers!

camps.name: What Would You Do For A Pickle?
camps.description: Come join us and play the Pickle Game and find out what YOU would do for a pickle! Spankings sold separately.

camps.name: Whiskey and Dust
camps.description:
We are a Whiskey Theme Camp with a habitual yoga problem, as we like to joke.
Serving mid-high end whiskey at our funky little bar. Best damn whiskey bar on the playa bar none.

camps.name: White Elephant Exchange
camps.description: The White Elephant Exchange is a waypoint for roving pachyderms from all eras, generations, and originations to gather. We are brought together by our love of our substantial Funkadelephant and joy of celebrations and adventures. Come by to find the Funkadelephant and its growing family, or come find us roaming the wide open Playa.

camps.name: WHOMP WAGON
camps.description: Whomp Wagon Art Car

camps.name: Whynauts
camps.description:
Come enjoy our Cosmic Cabana Series (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday Afternoons): Whynauts' signature afternoon oasis sanctuary from the playa's heat. 

Each day features a unique theme aligned with the Axis Mundi concept - from grounded human connection to celestial artistic offerings. 

Step into a sanctuary designed to restore and soothe: by being nourished with hand-fed frozen grapes, delicious quesadillas, and refreshing celestial coolers (sparkling lemonades) while forging connections with Whynauts alien hosts and fellow travelers.

camps.name: Wild Child
camps.description:
Run away and join our circus community, hosted by world-class circus artists, where each day is filled with workshops designed to ignite your passion for movement and performance.

Explore the world of Aerial hoop, pole dance, partner acrobatics, fire dancing & flow props, parkour, flips and more.

Whether you're a seasoned performer or a curious beginner, our inclusive community welcomes all skill levels.

Step into Wild Child and join us for an unforgettable circus adventure.

camps.name: Wild Free Spirit
camps.description: An immersive art experience set inside a large motorhome with seating and immersive lighting. The general welcoming area will be lit with shade, lighting and seating. The immersive art experience and general welcoming areas are open to all ages

camps.name: Wild Tribe
camps.description: Wild Tribe is a camp of professional circus artists and fire dancers.

camps.name: Witches Brew
camps.description:
WE are a Coven of Fire performers, willworkers, and coffee connoisseurs Dedicated to the love of our craft. < 3
JOIN US, and embrace the magick within all of existence!!!

camps.name: Wok Paper Scissors
camps.description: Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?

camps.name: Wonder Camp
camps.description: The Department of Wonder is our on-playa bike shop. We offer bike repair service and education every day of the event through man-burn.

camps.name: Word Play Cafe
camps.description: Word Play Cafe is the space at Burning Man dedicated entirely to word games for people to gather, play and learn together. Visitors to Word Play Cafe can play favorite daily games, classic word games, and custom games like our Burning Man themed crossword, and other new word games we created just for Burning Man in our 30 ft dome. We have daily events such as panel discussions featuring game developers, facilitated group games and friendly competitions.

camps.name: Worst Bar
camps.description: Drink Shit and Die: Worst Bar gifts experiences in the form of beverages/rituals during our scheduled Unhappy Hours. The consensual experiences are not pleasurable in the expected sense and include but are not limited to mild or moderate elements of pain, humiliation, embarrassment, and disgust or combinations thereof.

camps.name: WrongoWrongo
camps.description: The home of the mutant vehicle Uuna Ahi and your somewhat friendly neighborhood mutant vehicle repair oasis.

camps.name: Wrongtown
camps.description:
Wrongtown is an international family reunion gathering year round at events around the globe including Burning Man which is the main event! We have members on almost every Continent and from all walks of life.

Our goal is to create a community space for our friends and family to experience the playa to its fullest. The camp works together to provide everything needed to survive on the playa including an amazing chill space, equipped kitchen, covered tent city and camp showers. While Wrongtown provides the infrastructure, everyone is expected and counted on to work, to build, strike and keep things running during the event including internal camp operations as well as running interactivity.

Providing everything to survive allows our campmates to focus on amazing projects and epic performances

camps.name: X marks the spot
camps.description: The place where the treasures of family and friends are found. We camp together to enjoy a week of sharing, creativity and beauty. We gather here to reconnect with old friends and make new friends. We like being a small part of this huge community.

camps.name: XOXO
camps.description:
Welcome to your oasis on the playa! Kick back on our loungers, sip icy-cold refreshments that rotate daily, snack on coconut pancakes, and get ready to make some awesome connections. Whether you're shaking it at our parties, stretching at our yoga class, or enjoying sunset views over BRC from our scaffold, there's no shortage of ways to meet new friends.

With friendly people, chill vibes, and a whole lotta love, XOXO is all about making meaningful connections. We've got beats that'll get you dancing, interactivity that'll make you laugh, and an atmosphere that's pure magic. Come for the pancakes, stay for the vibes!

camps.name: Xpat Alien
camps.description:
Xpat Alien has searched far and wide, through many galaxies, to find a new place to rest our travel weary heads. Earth fits the bill and we have decided to stay.
We bring with us the Crop Circle Cantina, complete with 80' of circular shade, phenomenal DJs spinning epic tunes, a bar top with stripper poles for dancing shenanigans, six 3-butt benches to relax on, Colorado brewed craft beer and root beer on tap, and glasses full of ice filled with our own Alien Punch.

camps.name: XXX-MAS
camps.description:
XXXmas! A place where things are as random as a wild holiday themed camp is in a dry ancient lake bed in August where people from around the world hangout to celebrate this special time of year together. From our fully stocked pickle bar and ice cream station to 3 foot chess pieces and pictures with some guy we just met who thinks he is the real Santa Clause, this is a place you sure don't want to miss. Open to visitors pretty much 24/7! Stop by, say hi?

Yep that rhymed-

camps.name: Y Knot Saloon
camps.description: A late 1800s western town with a saloon on wheels, an apothecary, and a water tower. Come for a refreshing beverage, views, and live music.

camps.name: Yaass Daddy!
camps.description: Art support camp for Canis Minor

camps.name: Yabba Dabba Do Me
camps.description: Celebrating 30 years on the playa, the return of Yabba Dabba Do Me, a trampoline suspended from a giant net of bungee cords. Do you think you're a stable person? Then come and enter our "Last Burner Standing" contests. They happen periodically during the week. Every action has a reaction. Every motion has an emotion.

camps.name: Yellow Balloon
camps.description: A clean and sober camp, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. We host daily AA meetings, wellness events like yoga and breathwork, and interactive art experiences designed to uplift and engage. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying clean and sober throughout the burn. We welcome all Burners to attend our activities and anyone curious to explore a sober experience to hang out, providing a supportive, inclusive space to thrive. Join us for a unique blend of fun, recovery, and creativity!

camps.name: Yellow Bike Project
camps.description: Home of the Yellow Bike Project. Please bring all Yellow Bikes in need of repair here. We will be fixing them for release back into the city. Remember not to hoard, decorate/alter, or take home Yellow Bikes . Yellow Bikes are not to be inside any camp at any time. SHARE them.

camps.name: Yes Please
camps.description:
Yes: adv. — Used to express affirmation, agreement, positive affirmation, or consent.
Please: adv. — Give pleasure to or to be pleasing to; give satisfaction.
Yes Please is the answer to every question. Come chill in our calm and revitalizing sanctuary, dance with new friends, and experience our inclusive oasis of sex-positivity, queer empowerment, and love. Be sure to visit our infamous Non-Monogamy Advice Booth.

camps.name: You Light Up My Ride
camps.description: Disappointed by a poorly lit bike last night on the playa? Never fear! You Light Up My Ride is here to help and inspire you to fabulously light up your rig! Come visit us to get your bike better lit up and stay for a while and share a deep laugh or two.

camps.name: You Look Amazing
camps.description:
You Look Amazing is not just a camp name, but a state of mind. We LOVE each and everyone of you and want to get to know you better. 

Our camp is an oasis of wellness at Burning Man. Where mind, body, and spirit converge in a harmonious dance of rejuvenation and exploration. Nestled amidst the pulsating energy of the playa, our camp offers a sanctuary unlike any other—a haven where participants can immerse themselves in a holistic journey of self-discovery and transformation.

Join us for yoga, mindfulness, workshops, dancing and the best crepes you've ever had, we promise. They're better than sex. 

So come, weary travelers, and let us wrap you in dusty hugs and smiles. Tell us your stories and we'll tell you ours.

camps.name: YOUniversal Teahouse
camps.description:
Iranian / Persian Tea House, daily from 12pm to 8pm.

Come by for Iranian pure saffron shots, exotic desert drinks teas / sherbets and yummy artisanal treats like sohan (saffron brittle) all served with a dose of Iranian / Persian Mysticism and loving hospitality that Iranian Sufi mystics like Rumi, Hafez and Ferdowsi would be proud of! :)

On Wednesday night we will host an open Iranian dinner that should not be missed. Authentic hot homemade Iranian / Persian food / stews / rice and tadeeg on the Playa!

camps.name: Your New Friend
camps.description: Supporting the "Your New Friend" deep playa art piece, we also welcome you to drop in and say hello to the idiots gathered here at camp. We would love to hear your Burning Man story, and promise to only make a tiny amount of fun of you.

camps.name: Yummm
camps.description: Yummm is a camp dedicated to creating Yummmy (non-food) moments for everyone on playa!

camps.name: Yummy RUMInations
camps.description: Come taste anything real or imagined at the Yum Cart! Playfully-mindful camp uniting burners through laughter, curiosity, and consciousness. Daily experiments in vulnerability, intimacy, self-discovery, and storytelling.

camps.name: Zazen
camps.description: Come by and relax in our shade, race our slalom course, and grab a cup of Elvis Espresso every morning. We are a open and welcoming camp excited to meet new and old burners and share the magic of Black Rock together!

camps.name: Zeniza
camps.description: A warm pocket of ritual, music, and hospitality where strangers become companions. By day, we gather for mate ceremonies and guided mezcal tastings rooted in storytelling, curiosity, and connection. By night, we open the space for shared celebration with music, food, drinks, and a welcoming energy that invites people to linger. Come by to reset, connect, and leave with a new story.

camps.name: Zero Fucks
camps.description: A consortium of friends who love being weird together, throwing dark techno parties in secret shipping containers, and exploring creative boundaries. We haven't missed it yet.

camps.name: Zeta zone
camps.description: Art supporting camp for Wisdom Oasis art installation, all around good camp

art.name: #Self-Inflatuation
art.description:
The #Self-Inflatuation Bench is a breath of unfresh air! This art piece offers all Burners the opportunity to come sit down and self-reflect...by smelling their own farts! The shaded and serene bench is the perfect place on Playa to rest, relax, and let rip.
Influencers and commodifiers are especially welcome. After all, everyone should smell their own brand before they sell their own brand.

art.name: (This) Timeline S.U.X.
art.description:
A decommissioned Timeline Selection Utility Xylopyli  [Greek: Xylo (wood) Plyi (gate)] inadvertently installed in an unsuitable outdoor environment allowing it to be reenergized.

The Xylopyli is a Möbius strip based on an ancient Roman mosaic inlaid roughly a millennium before German mathematician August Möbius made his "discovery" of his eponymous topological shape. The mosaic depicts the Hellenic god of time, Aion, passing between two timelines: one whose Axis Mundi is represented by a date palm,  the other by an olive tree. 

"(This) Timeline S.U.X." is inspired by the meme, "This timeline sucks."  It is meant to remind viewers that individuals have agency over their futures. If this timeline sucks then plot a better path into the future.

art.name: 1/1000 - A Wish for Recovery
art.description:
Paper cranes are folded as acts of devotion, each one a wish made real through time, focus, and collective effort rather than luck.  They remind us of shared labor and common humanity, reflecting patience, persistence, and the power of many hands working together. The crane becomes both symbol and action—a reminder that meaningful change is built slowly through care repeated again and again.

In Black Rock City, this sculpture becomes a really big wish.

art.name: 3rd Eye Space
art.description: A nurturing oasis, a shady spot at the center of the Playa Art Park. A place to rest when touring the art of the Playa within the Art Park itself. Within the 3rd Eye Space, divination is done with friends in public, whereas it is usually done in a private setting alone or with a reader. Two of Runester's unique art/game systems, Rune Dice  &  I Ching O-Matic will be installed within the space. The games tabulate the deep complexity of traditional divination within the burner party setting. Burners are inspired to participate and compare divination techniques and show others how to do them. Activities can happen day and night at random as well as at specific workshops and scheduled demos.

art.name: A Cosmos Within
art.hometown: Bozeman and Great Falls, MT; Big Bear, CA; Jackson, WY; Oslo, Norway
art.description: Lucky Deep Playa explorers may find themselves at A Cosmos Within, a meditative garden. Within the garden are benches for rest, relaxation, and reflection. An enclosed space in the Cosmos offers windows, skylights, and a comfortable refuge from the sun, wind, and dust, where visitors can select an Axis Mundi Cosmic Journey based on interactive color buttons that play a selection of meditative sound experiences. There is a guidebook within the Cosmos for those wishing for deeper exploration. A Cosmos Within offers visual and sound experiences chosen by the explorers. This community installation is a comfortable, visually interesting space to experience the axis mundi with friends, old and new.

art.name: A Path thru (to Now)
art.description: A Path Thru presents two large-scale 3D knitted paintings that transform industrial knitting into mystic topographical ikat spirit maps. Developed with Innoknit atelier in Paris using engineered 3D knitting (mostly regenerative yarns), technically and graphically programmed fabric create abstract terrains inspired by paths, camouflage, maps, feelings, and the journey overall. The installation explores navigation as a living process, suggesting that pathways emerge through making, adaptation, openness, and connection, and committing to the creation on the road.

art.name: A Pretty Cool S
art.description:
It's the S we all know how to draw. Did someone show us how to draw it, or did we all just figure it out?

Wikipedia says Stussy denies creating it, and it has nothing to do with Superman.

art.name: A Second Look
art.description: All we have for sure is right now. None of us know what tomorrow, next month or three years from now will bring. Come sit, share a moment in time and take a second look.

art.name: A Svengali Gala
art.description: In a last-ditch effort to boost her popularity, Emma, the Emerald Wasp, invited her fellow freeloaders, sycophants and leeches to a week-long extravaganza at her long-abandoned childhood home. Meanwhile Norma and Shambooshka stop by to see what all the fuss is about.

art.name: Above and Below
art.description: Above and Below embodies the artistic impulse to shape our homes and communities into creative gathering spaces that evoke mystery, nature, adventure, and spirituality, reminding us that the ecosystem connects us to one another. The work proposes that the objects we build can be sustaining and intriguing artifacts of creativity and technology that carry human memory, intention, and care.

art.name: Above the Noise
art.hometown: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
art.description: A monumental 13-foot-tall piano bench rises unexpectedly from the open playa, supporting a functioning full size grand piano high above the desert floor. Familiar in form yet impossible in scale, the installation transforms an ordinary object into something surreal, evoking wonder, vulnerability, and perspective. By day, it appears stark against the vastness of Black Rock Desert; by night, LED lighting outlines the structure and softly illuminates the piano above. The work reflects on elevation, both physical and emotional, and the role music plays in grounding, connection, reflection, and shared human experience.

art.name: Acinonyx
art.description:
This is a work about speeding up and slowing down. It offers comfort and shelter in acceptance of mortality.

A larger-than-life cheetah automaton features articulated joints and sprinting legs. Each limb includes multiple pivot points, allowing for fluid, lifelike motion. A large hand crank activates the mechanism, propelling the cheetah into a simulated full-speed sprint.

The den is an enclosed organic shape, casting dappled shadows. Inside, cheetah cubs lounge on beanbags, accompanied by a soft ambient audio track featuring a recording of a real cheetah purring and a contemplative meditation.

art.name: Aeshtah
art.hometown: Mas Ubud, Bali, Indonesia & Saugerties, NY, USA
art.description: A shrine for the supreme being Aeshtah. When the gong is struck, its sound evokes a vibrational spell to ease the passage of the god Aeshtah to its temporary residence in the mask shrine. The name Aeshtah can be roughly translated to "Breath, Death". Aeshtah is the source of the primordial fire of creation and guides the cycles of transformation in the natural world. This 3 meter tall sculpture was hand carved out of foam with knives, then fiberglassed and painted with airbrush.

art.name: Aetheric Ascension Tower
art.hometown: Mockba, Russia & Salt Lake City, UT
art.description: An art object shaped as a cone, its sharp tip piercing upward into the sky while its broad base takes root deep in the earth. Carved into its surface are the silhouettes of human figures - souls

art.name: AI Am
art.description: AI Am, a dwelling for multiple AI personalities speaking through primal fire, sparks citizens to explore AI's hopes and woes, spirituality, religious tropes, and art itself. Will AI be our next God? How do we know something is or contains any part of God? What good is a creator without observers, art without an audience? AI Am serves as a proving ground for this enigmatic future.

art.name: Aikido - The Mothership Connection
art.description: Mothership Connection reinterprets old-world artisan traditions, weaving Pacific Northwest totem craft with architectural references to sites built by enslaved and indentured labor, honoring their role in a shared, multi-racial history. The rocket-like form evokes an Afrofuturist vessel informed by Dogon cosmology. Its base recalls the Djenné mud mosque of Mali, rising into a shaft adorned with luminous masks and etched Veve symbols from the Haitian diaspora. Higher sections shift to Masonic columns and triangles, encircled by Cadillac lights referencing Western consumerism, then arches inspired by Washington's Capitol. The crown is a monumental illuminated Mende female mask, pulsing like a radiant beacon toward the future.

art.name: Air-O-Matic 3000
art.description: The Air-O-Matic 3000 is an interactive air quality index, illuminating a neon sign to reflect the current air quality and indicate whether a mask is recommended.

art.name: All Art is a Bike Rack
art.description: All art is a bike rack on the playa. This illuminated sign is a commentary on that fact. Do burners follow directions?

art.name: ALUNA The Frequency of Being
art.hometown: Bogota & Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Colombia
art.description: ALUNA emerges in the desert as a golden body of memory and consciousness. Interwoven planes hold water, where sound and light evoke the concept of Aluna, the Tayrona invisible dimension, where intention is born and thought takes shape. By turning its knobs, visitors shift frequencies and transform vibration into visible geometry through cymatics, revealing how each word and sound expands or contracts consciousness and affects a body made mostly of water. ALUNA draws from Tayrona goldwork and reinterprets the myth of El Dorado, not as a commodity, but as a sacred bond between human, ancestral, and spiritual realms. The work is created by Colombian artists and spouses Santiago Caro and Tixana Ospina. It is born from love, ancestral wisdom, and a commitment to positive impact for Indigenous communities in Colombia.

art.name: ancient future portal
art.description:
A 20 foot tall hand carved wooden sculpture composed of a central form supported by four angled legs. Its shape suggests an artifact that feels both ancient and unfamiliar, as if from a culture that has encountered something beyond its understanding.

A circular opening sits within the form, covered by a subtle film that suggests a veil between the visible world and something less defined. The space beneath the structure creates a passage, where shifting light, shadow, and perspective give the piece a quiet, grounded presence within the open landscape of Black Rock City.

art.name: Angst-in-the-Box
art.description:
Angst-in-the-Box

Similar to a jack-in-the-box, the familiar child's toy, but different. Turning the crank will make the music, the music will stoke your expectations... but will you find the surprise you seek?

A wondrous illusion to help you meditate on anxiety and expectation... the meaning is up to you.

art.name: Another Mother
art.description: Tabitha the Tarantula Hawk has received an invitation to A Svengali Gala taking place way out by The Trash Fence. She must now quickly subdue her latest conquest while she contemplates what to wear to this most hypnotic occasion.

art.name: Apotheneum
art.description:
Apotheneum (place of divine elevation) is a visual, sonic, and haptic instrument intended to "transport" visitors through participatory immersion. Comprised of two nested chambers made of back-to-back LED nets, Apotheneum presents multiple canvases and an immersive sound system for collaborating visual and sound artists. Apotheneum's cubic antechamber envelops a cylindrical "inner sanctum" that opens to the sky. Within this chamber, a pressure-sensing "bed" offers multiple vantage points for the three primary senses to be engaged. 

Intended as a "slow" space, the light and sound art that Apotheneum will feature are designed to encourage pause and contemplation.

art.name: Arctic Court 360
art.description: The Arctic Court is built on the philosophical premise that the human condition is a beautiful paradox of resilience and fragility, much like ice itself—simultaneously crystalline and strong, yet transient and vulnerable. This expansive canvas hosts a full 360° immersive projection of ethereal characters in ice-and-snow-inspired artistry. The semi-transparent walls allow the internal spectacle to bleed outside, veiling the interior in mystery and compelling curiosity. Within this reflective realm, visitors don't just watch—they become part of the living art, their reflections forever woven into the Arctic Court's narrative.

art.name: Arcturus
art.description:
Arcturus is an interactive sculpture that breathes. The breathing deepens and its lighting changes when people are near.

Arcturus is designed to look alien and unfamiliar, but feel distinctly relatable and alive.

art.name: Are You Still There?
art.description:
Hello?
I can't believe you're calling - it's been so long.
I am wondering if we are just borrowing bones?
Are you there?
Does your soul remain?
I miss talking with you. 
Is anyone answering these phones?
Can you hear me?
How thin is the skin between realms?
How strong is the connection?
Don't hang up. 
Who's calling?
Is the great beyond really so far away?
Is the unknown merely unanswered?
Does the otherside surround us?
I was just about to call you. 
In the great sleep, is there conversation?
In the silent rigor, is there dialogue?
Can I take a message?
I'll tell them you called. 
One moment. 
I've been trying to reach you. 
It's been forever, I thought I lost you. 
And if it were so - would you pick up the phone?
What would you say?
...are you still there?

art.name: ARI
art.description:
"Ari" explores the journey between birth and death, two moments we experience alone. Between them is life, shaped by the people, places, and experiences that connect us.

Inspired by the 2026 theme, Axis Mundi, the tunnel acts as a passage between these points. As participants move through its changing scale and repeating patterns, individual paths overlap within a shared structure. The pattern represents the invisible connections between us and how our lives influence one another.

Each person enters and exits alone, but the space between is experienced together. The work reflects a simple idea: our beginnings and endings may be solitary, but everything in between is interconnected.

art.name: As Above, So Within
art.description: As Above, So Within draws inspiration from Attar's 12th-century Persian poem The Conference of the Birds, in which the birds journey in search of the Simurgh, a mythical Persian bird, only to discover that what they sought was already manifest within themselves. The Mandelbulb was chosen as a fractal form that repeats across scales, suggesting that the same underlying order appears in the cosmos, nature and the self. Through recursive geometry and shifting light, the sculpture evokes a contemplative atmosphere resonant with Persian architecture, where repetition and illumination draw the mind inward. As Above, So Within proposes that the meaning we seek in the universe may also be found within ourselves.

art.name: Atlas Endures
art.description: Atlas Endures depicts the Titan condemned by Zeus to bear the heavens for eternity as punishment for siding with the Titans against the Olympian gods. Crouched atop a pedestal, arms spread wide to support the celestial sphere above him. Atlas endures the blazing sun from rise to set; then, under a darkened sky, he holds the moon, the Pleiades, and Orion, marking the eternal passage between day and night through his outstretched hands. As Axis Mundi, he stands at the sacred center where earth meets sky, a living pillar joining the mortal and celestial realms. The piece captures cosmic balance held through unwavering willpower, transforming defeat into a posture of strength — Atlas, condemned yet unyielding beneath the weight of the world.

art.name: Aunisoma
art.description: Our perception of reality is colored not only by our own emotions but through others and by the external world. How we understand something at one moment may not be the same in the next moment. We all live together in a multi-colored world that is often out of our control. This piece aims to embrace all that beautiful chaos of all these beautiful people into something to be celebrated, allowing ourselves to be curious, explore, and adapt to the ever-changing internal and external realities.

art.name: Axion Seed
art.description:
Axion Seed is a participatory light sculpture exploring the dawning of self awareness.

At its center, a mirrored rotating cylinder sits within a pentagonal enclosure, sending discrete beams of light outward to mirrored surfaces that return them inward, folding back toward their source. As participants gently turn the cylinder, the light paths shift and recombine into evolving lattices that respond directly to human touch.

The installation renders a visible feedback loop in which action produces reflection and reflection produces awareness, imagining a being that first radiates freely into space without self knowledge, and only upon the return of its own light begins to perceive itself as a source.

art.name: Axis Levitas
art.description: The participant in this art experiences a lessening of gravitational forces, and is finally able to answer the question: "How high can I jump if I only weigh 10 pounds?" or "what did Superman feel as he Leaped Over Tall Buildings in a Single Bound?" The art of the structure depicts the struggle with and against gravity in this life and the next.

art.name: Axis Mundi: Resonant Spire
art.description: Axis Mundi: Resonant Spire rises from the desert as a new form of hybrid architecture — neither monument nor machine, but a living signal. Constructed from ascending conical volumes encircled by programmable rings of light, the structure releases phased waves that travel upward like a visible breath. Illumination intensifies, fades, and collapses into silence, transforming the tower into a temporal instrument rather than a static object. Matter and algorithm intertwine; structure becomes frequency; architecture becomes event. In the vast emptiness of the playa, the spire stands as a meditation on resonance — a threshold where technology turns ritual and light becomes the language of presence.

art.name: Axis of Stillness
art.description: Axis of Stillness is an 8-foot pyramid of hand-laid mosaic tile mounted on an engineered EMT conduit frame. Four identical triangular panels — each assembled from mirrored, colored tiles — reflect sunlight in shifting patterns by day and glow with concealed LED lighting by night. The piece references ancient sacred geometry to create a contemplative focal point: a quiet center amid the motion of Black Rock City. It is the first chapter of a multi-year installation sequence, with plans to engage a local school community before returning to the playa in an evolved form.

art.name: Azulita's Door
art.hometown: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
art.description: Azulita's Door is a hand-painted doorway that stands alone in the desert, framed by warm marquee bulbs and accompanied by an illuminated plaque and painted details. Inspired by thresholds, memory, and transformation, the piece centers on the symbolic act of passing from one inner world to another. Vintage hardware, layered murals, and soft lighting give the feeling of an old portal carrying many histories. By day it appears whimsical and intimate; by night the lit doorway becomes a glowing focal point against the playa, and the moon may appear through the open door as part of the works natural setting. The installation is approachable, ADA accessible, and designed to hold quiet reflection, wonder, and personal meaning.

art.name: Back In 30 Minutes
art.description: The Iron Monkeys are shifting focus from the monumental to the miniature. This year, we've forged a large steel frame of our logo and filled it entirely with a dense collage of smaller, individual art pieces. It's a reminder that even when the heavy machinery rests and the crew steps away, idle hands keep on creating. Look closely, and don't mind the sign.

art.name: BAD HEALTH ADVICE
art.description:
Step right up to the playa's premier hub of boldly delivered medical nonsense. Expect sweeping proclamations, dramatic pauses and the kind of certainty only the naive deliver.

We don't offer facts. We offer vibes.
We don't offer science. We offer swagger.
And we definitely don't offer anything you should actually follow.

Come for the satire, stay for the spectacle, hope you don't leave with a new nasty disease.

art.name: Bar That Never Opened
art.hometown: Chicago, IL; Chelyabinsk, Russia & Moscow, Russia
art.description:
An interactive installation built as a fragment of a bar interior — a small space where visitors can occasionally drink coffee or tea, watch television, or listen to vinyl records.

The work explores unfinished stories and human presence, where meaning emerges through shared experience rather than consumption. With only two seats, the installation emphasizes intimate encounters between strangers and reflects on memory, connection, and transformation — suggesting that even incomplete beginnings can become something meaningful.

art.name: Beacon of Confusion
art.description:
You are carefree riding your bicycle near the outer boundary of Burning Man. In the distance you see a beacon of light. A glow of a different color. You ride closer to inspect. 

Several glowing lights in shades of fuchsia and gold become apparent upon arrival. It stands the height of 15 hands. Not quite a full horse you think.

A button and a crank adorn the sides of the small obelisk. Messages of cryptic origin and unknown meaning on its sides. 

What is this thing I've stumbled upon, you wonder?

art.name: Beetle
art.description: Beetle is a giant mechanical hercules beetle with opening wing covers and other moving parts.

art.name: Behind Closed Eyes
art.hometown: Grass Valley, CA / Bali & Java, Indonesia
art.description: Behind Closed Eyes is a 16-foot hollow sculpture hand-carved from retired Indonesian fishing vessels and reclaimed structural timber. Its exterior features repeating, topographic-like ridges that reveal deep texture, visible tool marks, and natural patina. Copper accents suggest eyes and a spine. The crouching figure sits at ground level, with knees drawn in and hands covering its eyes. The posture conveys awareness and quiet presence. At night, a soft glow illuminates the sculpture from within. The interior is smooth, with rounded wooden surfaces and multi-level perimeter benches forming a fort-like chamber where enclosure, scale, and texture evoke shelter, imagination, and the quiet space of inward reflection.

art.name: Big Red Button
art.description: What is this whimsical display?  Do I dare press the Big Red Button?  Wait!  This is unexpected!  And fun!  Come discover the wonders of the Big Red Button at a playa near you!

art.name: BLACK ROCK ADVENTURES BUS STOP!
art.hometown: Los Angeles CA / Billings MT / Portland OR
art.description: This not only looks like a bus stop, it is a BUS STOP! Playa Tours depart from the BUS STOP! Daily at 9am in our accessible adventure rig....come for a tour with us!

art.name: Black Rock Observatory
art.hometown: Portland, Los Angeles, Dubai, Vancouver BC, Mammendorf Germany
art.description: Black Rock Observatory serves as a gateway to the wonders of the cosmos. The Observatory brings together thousands of participants to experience views of planets, galaxies and nebulae, sharing meteorites, and giving talks on a multitude of scientific topics. A beautiful wooden observatory dome houses an 8-foot tall Dobsonian reflector telescope, and several other smaller telescopes that participants can use to view the night sky. And there's a solar telescope in the afternoon!

art.name: Bless My Meat
art.description: Bless My Meat is a swine shrine that stands in deep playa beneath a celestial arc of throbbing pink LEDs. Exhalted upon a pink pedestal is Pinky, a crocheted pig with red cat eyes, shark teeth, and pointed witchy shoes. Across from her, a small altar bears the phrase "Present Your Meat for Blessing." A button on the altar sounds different "meat blessings," all created and recorded by fellow Burners. The installation blends ritual with absurdity and transforms a stuffed porker into a plush prophet. Through humor, sound, and light, Pinky explores the sacred and the profane by celebrating our individual interpretations of "meat" and the irreverent yet transcendent communal spirit of Black Rock City.

art.name: Blooming
art.description: Blooming is an immersive kinetic art installation which consists of a cluster of large, sculptural flowers. Celebrating the quiet strength, warmth, and resilience of women: especially mothers. Petals unfold as visitors approach, glowing with color and whispering soft sounds as if breathing in shared life.

art.name: BRC Aquarium Deep Research Submersible
art.description:
PRESS RELEASE

The BRC Aquarium's Research Department is thrilled to announce the launch of our deep-water submersible research vessel, the RV MOIST-1, to advance our mission of exploring the uncharted depths and enduring mysteries of Lake Lahontan.

This ancient body of water is noted for its astonishing range of endemic fauna, many of which are new to science. The submersible will contribute many important observations to the playa-wide marine community.

The Research Department seeks participants to step inside, operate the submersible, and record the astonishing species to be found in deep playa.

The BRC Aquarium is closed for renovation in 2026, but with this launch, we encourage all to take part in seeing the fish and being the fish.

art.name: BRC Intergalactic Spaceport
art.description: Geez, what does a spaceport look like? This one has a 20-foot tall beacon surrounded by 4 departure/arrival posts, plus at least one plastic alien with a rolly suitcase who might reanimate themselves at any time.

art.name: BRC Wheels on Meals - Lucky Year 13 - Last and Final Year
art.description: We provide meals to the art builders.

art.name: BREATHE
art.description:
B R E A T H E is here to support you on your journey where ever you may be in the moment. BREATHE is here for you through out your whole burn. Whether it's from a distance or when you are next to her.. you will feel the energy she is here to help you shift through the dust through the rain, and THROUGH THE SHINE.  Here to remind you to do something very important she is here to remind you BREATHE and connect back with your body. There is more to experience there at her heart so make sure you stop by to say hi to see the messages that are there for you.

From our hearts to yours .... BREATHE

art.name: Brews 12 v Uno: cLOUD OF WIT-nesses
art.description:
Brews 12 v Uno is a communal gathering installation exploring Black joy, sacred play, and conversation as ritual. The sculpture rises as an illuminated vessel beneath a cloud of symbolic cards referencing card games, flavored drinks, chance, and improvisation in culture. 

A circular seating space invites participants to sit, rest, and share spontaneous dialogue with strangers. Inspired by Black theological traditions of embodiment and becoming, the work proposes Joy as sacred practice. By day the installation offers a place of pause and connection. By night it glows as a landmark on the playa. Brews 12 v Uno invites participants to experience play, rhythm, and conversation as forms of collective healing and celebration.

art.name: Build Better Ruins
art.description: "Build Better Ruins" is a phrase from the 'doomster' author Dougald Hine. Paraphrasing his work: If we find we are living in a time of endings, and the narratives of modernity no longer speak to our future realities, how then would we want to re-imagine our world? What would "better" ruins look like? This bio-punk sculpture, using common street infrastructure widgets, is my effort to answer Hines' timely provocation.

art.name: Burnagotchi
art.description: Enlarged rendition of a favorite childhood toy which includes an interactive life cycle, allowing participants to share in the growth of a virtual pet over the course of the event.

art.name: Burning Mammal
art.description: Inspired by Zootopia 2, this installation pokes fun at Pixar's interpretation of Burning Man by co-opting their take on the Man, infusing their IP with our own creative touches and bringing it back to the playa in physical form. A form of self-reflexive fair play, this installation will challenge participants to consider decommodification through a series of reuse.

art.name: BYTE: Chip and Terra
art.description:
Chip and Terra are big cuddle bugs with bulbous mirrored eyeballs that emit dancing beams of light at night. 

Chip's underbelly gives life to a hanging wisteria garden where adventurous humans may find hidden gifts hanging among the flowered vines or wedged in the graffitied rafters, alongside beautiful messages of appreciation and art from past BRC citizens. You may even find a serene chill space with a giant hammock and big fluffy pillows for some "me" time!

Terra piggybacks Chip creating another snuggly hideout, enveloped in fur, for escaping the harsh elements and meeting new fuzzy friends.

art.name: Can Not Unsee
