mutant_vehicles.description: A more apropriate name would be, DARK HORSE OF THE APOCALYPSE!" It's a long story.

mutant_vehicles.name: Chi11er
mutant_vehicles.description: Chi11er is a 15' tall mobile tower that delivers ice cream to Deep Playa, look us up!

mutant_vehicles.name: Chicken Dragon - Hatchery Gone Wrong
mutant_vehicles.description: Chicken Dragon is a hatchery contained in the dungeon in an old castle.  We have tried to obtain and hatch dragon eggs, but there have been issues, resulting in creatures that look a bit more like chickens.   Visitors to our dungeon will see that we are hard at work trying to produce new dragons or chickens, we are not sure what we will get next.  Our best hatchling grew large and protects our castle.  His fire comes from his comb though, not his mouth.  Nothing has gone quite right in the hatchery, but dancing in the dungeon and on the top of the castle will make up for our dragon-less frustration!

mutant_vehicles.name: Chosen Yogurt
mutant_vehicles.description: Yogurt - Chosen

mutant_vehicles.name: Classic Slide
mutant_vehicles.description: The Classic Slide is a circus tent you can climb and slide down from the top of

mutant_vehicles.name: Cleo
mutant_vehicles.description: Cerberus, the three headed dog

mutant_vehicles.name: Cloudius
mutant_vehicles.description: Taylor Dunn vehicle mutated into a steel armature in the shape of an Angel Wings over the clouds with a built-in cotton-candy maker Up in the front Covered with Crown wings Mask.

mutant_vehicles.name: Clown Car
mutant_vehicles.description: Clown Car is a small cart size vehicle with a giant yellow happy face in front and a giant red clown bowler on top.  The custom widened, low profile looking  metal body has a fire truck feel.  The custom upholstery adds a lot of great colors to the R G B L LED lighting system,

mutant_vehicles.name: Clyde the Ghost
mutant_vehicles.description: Clyde the ghost looks exactly like he came directly off the screen of PacMan the video game

mutant_vehicles.name: Coo Coo Cachoo
mutant_vehicles.description: Coo Coo Cachoo is a dapper, gentlemanly walrus art car with two large glowing LED tusks, a top hat, and cigar. Come find us for adventures!

mutant_vehicles.name: Copper Top
mutant_vehicles.description: Copper Top was built by artist Shawn Lusebrink (Pacific Renn) out of everyday objects. Everything from a dog dish to concrete tubes has gone into making this one of a kind piece.

mutant_vehicles.name: Cow
mutant_vehicles.description: Ride-able cow

mutant_vehicles.name: Cubeish
mutant_vehicles.description: A cube(ish) that lets you touch and hear and feel the music.

mutant_vehicles.name: Cubic Odyssey
mutant_vehicles.description: The Cubic Odyssey is a LED ice cube during the day providing a oasis in a hot dry dusty desert. at night it transforms into an Rubik's cube changing colours and looking for a solution. this puzzle will captivate burners from all over the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Cuddle Couch
mutant_vehicles.description: Built for comfort and cruising in style the Cuddle Couch is your safe space to relax with your Burner Amigos and take in all the magic the playa provides.

mutant_vehicles.name: Cyber Puss
mutant_vehicles.description: The Cyber Puss is an ultra futuristic kitty that prowls the streets of BRC mesmerizing all who see their reflection in her.

mutant_vehicles.name: Daddy Long Wheels
mutant_vehicles.description:
This mutant vehicle was built from the ground up specifically for BM.
It looks like a horseless carriage with custom 6 ft. diameter
"old wagon style" wheels. The driver and passengers ride on a big
flat comfortable piece of foam (like a queen size mattress), with a
big foam back support. The vehicle utilizes air-suspension, which can
raise and lower the vehicle like a low rider. When the suspension
is in the full "up" position, the top of the vehicle including the
driver and passengers heads (while seated) are about 10 ft. off the
ground, which makes the vehicle very unique and exciting to look at
and to ride on.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dakini Hathini
mutant_vehicles.description: A neon-pink fuzzy elephant glowing like cotton candy under the Black Rock sky. LED eyes twinkling, trunk swaying to the beat—pure playa magic on four fuzzy legs. Hop on and ride the chaos!

mutant_vehicles.name: DamnTrak
mutant_vehicles.description: The Historic "Not-Quite Public Transportation" double decker ghost train roams the Nevada desert again!

mutant_vehicles.name: Dandy
mutant_vehicles.description: Come take a magical ride on a floating bed of dandelions.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dandy Lion
mutant_vehicles.description: The Dandy Lion Bus is a 22 foot bus with a raised platform on top that has lots of space for hanging out and enjoying some music and good views.  We want to be adventurers and take friends to as many sites as we can.  During the day the Dandy Lion participates in the area transit program to offer rides to as many people as we can.  Our krewe started a friends and volunteers at Reggae on the River and Reggae Rising and brought our camp spirit and family to Burning Man to continue our legacy.  We are devoted to inclusion and love to hear people say that they are having their first ride on a mutant vehicle when they come aboard.

mutant_vehicles.name: DaVinci Solar Electric Dragonfly
mutant_vehicles.description: Since 2015 the Davinci Solar Electric Dragonfly escorts bicycles and carries up to 6 passengers across playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Deco Fish Twin #1
mutant_vehicles.description: The Deco Fish Twins are double decker, Art Deco-inspired deep sea fish with an intricate fully addressable LED lighting system, explosive flame effects from its antennae, and a 20,000 Watt pro audio sound system with three zones and room for a dozen bikes.

mutant_vehicles.name: Deco Fish Twin #2
mutant_vehicles.description: The Deco Fish Twins are double decker, Art Deco-inspired deep sea fish with an intricate fully addressable LED lighting system, explosive flame effects from its antennae, and a 20,000 Watt pro audio sound system with three zones and room for a dozen bikes.

mutant_vehicles.name: Deep Playa Express
mutant_vehicles.description: We crafted Deep Playa Express to offer a unique mix of the historical and the fantastical. This stationary oasis will stand as a beacon within the Choo Choo camp, welcoming weary travelers with the promise of adventure and the joy of deep electronic beats.

mutant_vehicles.name: DemiTrak
mutant_vehicles.description: DemiTrak is the lil' brother to Damntrak, a sport about for the more personal playa excursions.

mutant_vehicles.name: Der Stier
mutant_vehicles.description: Des Stier is a small mutant vehicle based on the game MineCraft.  German for 'The Bull', it is a longhorn steer/bull built around a pedal assist electric bike surrey.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dirty Bird Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: In 2017, the vehicle was introduced to playa. As an artist, I was completely inspired by what I was able to witness in 2016. As a result, I undertook a huge responsibility to create a brand new art car that would display my artistic vision. I started building the art car in 2016. Since it was my first year building an art car, I under estimated the amount of time it took to prepare something of that magnitude. In 2016, I was responsible for the design, fabrication, transportation, sound and operation of the vehicle.  In 2017, I reached out to every professional I knew for advise. Fortunately, I got assistance with sound, lighting and construction. The result was spectacular. Our team did exceptional in preparing the vehicle.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dirty Dinghy
mutant_vehicles.description: The Dirty Dinghy is a tiny, untrustworthy boat strapped to an electric tricycle, drifting across the dusty seas of Black Rock City in search of shady moments, smooth rides, and chapped lips to save. Built for absurd adventures and sunscreen gifting, this playa dinghy is captained by questionable intentions and fueled by bad ideas (electric bad ideas). Hop aboard if you're lost, sunburnt, or just looking for trouble—no lifejacket required.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dirty Goat Roadhouse
mutant_vehicles.description:
A time-worn roadhouse bar shrouded in a towering goat skull with LED horns, rolling slowly across the dust.

Look for this horny beast!

mutant_vehicles.name: Disco Hauler
mutant_vehicles.description: The Disco Crew and its helpers will spread joy and cheer to the Burners and dancers around the playa and give thanks and appreciation to the best week of my life.

mutant_vehicles.name: Disco Roboto Iron GIant
mutant_vehicles.description: Disco Roboto Iron Giant is a playa people mover, inspiring dance, laughter, lights, flames, and community.

mutant_vehicles.name: Disco Snail
mutant_vehicles.description: Micro disco snail built on an electric wheelchair base

mutant_vehicles.name: Disco Space Shuttle
mutant_vehicles.description: Join us on the Disco Space Shuttle, a warm chill-out refuge during deep playa music gatherings, positive music, and a ride home in the early morning for the weary.

mutant_vehicles.name: Discohover and Discolounge
mutant_vehicles.description: Discohover and Discolounge is the Future Retro Playground for your Playa Alteration Fun.  Discohover the Playa, Lounge at your favorite Disco.

mutant_vehicles.name: Disorient Express
mutant_vehicles.description: The last train out of everywhere, heading somewhere new. Born from the rusted rail yards of Europe and pointed vaguely at outer space, the Disorient Express runs no fixed schedule and stops wherever it feels right. Climb aboard, find a seat, meet your fellow passengers. The destination is unknown but the ride is the point.

mutant_vehicles.name: DogFish
mutant_vehicles.description: DogFish is one of the few remaining bar cars gifting beverages and water to anyone who needs a drink. Riders can sit comfortably on the outside barstools and back bench, or inside on the two long couches. Our bartenders are sure to make you smile!

mutant_vehicles.name: Don't Fuckin Care Bear
mutant_vehicles.description:
Don't Fuckin Care Bear is a giant, low-poly aluminum bear riding on a glowing white cloud. With blinking LED eyes,
heart-lit feet, and a secret DJ booth in its chest, it's part sculpture, part cuddle-powered dance party, part rolling
emotional support animal. By day it shines like a silver gem; by night it lights up with soft backlighting and playful neon
accents. Built by a diverse, international crew, the bear rolls through the playa as a mobile mood-lifter, offering music,
shade, and joy to anyone who needs a little reminder not to take life too seriously.

mutant_vehicles.name: Don't Panic
mutant_vehicles.description:
Deep Thought is a colossal supercomputer and spaceship mutant vehicle inspired by The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. From the outside it appears as a towering robot with a head of giant glowing screens, powered by a neon-lit city.
We built it as a playful, sarcastic reflection on humanity's growing reliance on AI. While the 2026 theme Axis Mundi explores the natural cosmic axis of existence, Deep Thought humorously asks whether artificial intelligence can compute the Ultimate Answer to Life, the Universe, and Everything.
Inside the darkened starship, plush couches await travelers for an immersive interstellar journey. Climb aboard, contribute your thoughts, and hitch a ride. We hope to deliver the Answer before the week ends.

mutant_vehicles.name: DragonRider
mutant_vehicles.description:
DragonRider is a delightful recreation of a 20 foot captured green Sea Dragon restrained on top of a small Viking Longboat. 
Watch in fascination as he shakes her head snaps her jaws flaps her fins, shakes her tail and bellows in complaint at her capture. Watch out she may spray you with a mist of seawater if you get too close!

mutant_vehicles.name: Dream Drifter
mutant_vehicles.description: Dream Drifter is a solar-powered canopy-bed that moves you seamlessly between dreams and the magic of the desert.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dream Genie
mutant_vehicles.description: A magical traveling genie bottle

mutant_vehicles.name: Dreamtime MV
mutant_vehicles.description: Dreamtime encourages and inspires us to unwind, unlock, and let our minds run free with imagination and curiosity. An island of calm in deep playa and beyond, find us and dream together.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dreamy Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: Dreamy is a radically inclusive platform for connection. We provide a welcoming, relaxed, comfortable and luxurious space to make new friends while enjoying the art.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dukduk
mutant_vehicles.description: The DukDuk covered wagon designed by Ivy Waegel and Calli Beck

mutant_vehicles.name: Dust Slug
mutant_vehicles.description: Dust Slug is a prehistoric beast reincarnated from the dust of the dry Lahontan lakebed that is now called Black Rock Desert. With dazzling nighttime color displays and tentacles blowing in the wind it entrances BRC citizens to join it in its endless wandering.

mutant_vehicles.name: Dust-e
mutant_vehicles.description: After WALL-E cleaned up all the MOOP on Earth for humanity, he decided to head to Burning Man with his Playa name "DUST-E". His new directive will be clearing MOOP in the  Black Rock City with his cute appearance and innocent demeanor. He's looking forward to interfacing and shaking his can at Robot Heart.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eagle 5
mutant_vehicles.description: It's a well represented copy of the iconic Spaceballs rv .

mutant_vehicles.name: Earth and Sky
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Earth and Sky is a fully transformed Mutant Vehicle that bears no resemblance to its base chassis. The vehicle presents as a 10-foot diameter extraterrestrial scout craft resting on armored tank treads. All automotive cues have been eliminated. No visible car body panels, headlights, bumpers, or stock framing remain.
The sculpted fiberglass hull, integrated lighting band, and open-air square cockpit establish a complete visual transformation consistent with Burning Man's Mutant Vehicle requirements. The craft reads clearly as an art object first and transportation second.

mutant_vehicles.name: Earth Exploration Vehicle 101
mutant_vehicles.description: A small manned exploration rover, built to observe the creatures of Earth among their routine day to day lives.

mutant_vehicles.name: Echolalia
mutant_vehicles.description: A multimedia synesthetic time portal  that fosters community, creativity, and play.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eden
mutant_vehicles.description: Come dance in the dust with Eden! You won't hear a lot of house music here (nor jazz over my dead body), as we strive to bring you the good and sometimes unusual. Plenty of DJ time, but we try to mix in live performances as well. Find us wherever at night, and days at Camp Square One (where we serve hot lunch every day)

mutant_vehicles.name: Edna The Elephant
mutant_vehicles.description: A fire breathing, laser cut, stainless steel and wood combination providing interactivity and baselines for the Playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Eileen, The Pearl Peacock
mutant_vehicles.description: "Eileen" the Pearl Peacock has five majestic metal tail feathers and white lace body. At night she shines bright on the playa. This piece is a homage to creativity and storytelling from around the world.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eitherlight
mutant_vehicles.description: Eitherlight emerges and merges from the past and the future together, offering a place of celebration and relaxation for weary playa wanderers. Come to Eitherlight to receive and reprieve everything you've wanted and then some. If you're cooked and cold, we will whip you up some cocoa. We cookin' yo!

mutant_vehicles.name: El Mango
mutant_vehicles.description: El Mango, a floating mango riding in the middle of the desert.

mutant_vehicles.name: El Pulpo Magnifico
mutant_vehicles.description: A popular and friendly flaming scrap metal octopus.

mutant_vehicles.name: Electric Candy Car
mutant_vehicles.description:
Electric Candy Car, the colorful bursting bag of candies which invites you to hop on for a
sweet, joyful journey.

mutant_vehicles.name: Electric Toadstool
mutant_vehicles.description: This scratch-built electric vehicle is remotely controlled, carries up to 8 people, and features over 3,000 LEDs plus a misting system to keep riders cool.

mutant_vehicles.name: Elektra
mutant_vehicles.description: Elektra is a fire breathing dragon with 60' wings swathed in remarkable addressable and sequenced LEDs.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eleonore
mutant_vehicles.description: Passenger friendly land submarine

mutant_vehicles.name: Emergence
mutant_vehicles.description: Lounge, canopy, wings, lights, hearts. We recreate Emergence every year for the love and Community it brings to the Playa. we bring a fun loving experience Through music dance and art we love to serve the community by transporting people to their favorite destinations of art music parties and when necessary to services such as Medical Center Camp Etc our goal is to give community members the best Burning Man experience possible and to promote the vibration of love throughout. welcoming all with open arms

mutant_vehicles.name: Excite Trike
mutant_vehicles.description: The Excite Trike is a unique and eccentric looking trike with 7-foot diameter wheels fun banners and loads of LEDs that is guaranteed to bring both smiles and long stares during the day and at night time.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eye Of Providence
mutant_vehicles.description: The all-seeing eye symbolizes the eye of God always watching. Giving it a meta representation of week that goes on during Burning Man. Deep in the lore of the all-seeing eye is the connection to the Freemasons, giving the Eye of Providence a connection to the counterculture of society.

mutant_vehicles.name: Eyezekiel
mutant_vehicles.description: A biblically accurate angel with wings, rings, and googly eyes.

mutant_vehicles.name: F-15 Interceptor - Black Rock Air Force
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Black Rock Air Force's F-15 Interceptor is a 40% scale model of the McDonnell-Douglas F-15D Eagle. On the playa since 2007, it has seen service as an Airport Follow-Me vehicle, Ranger transport, and on reconnaissance missions throughout inner and outer playa. 


It is built on an electric golf cart base and was created using fiberglass, steel, wood, foam, and high-intensity LEDs.

mutant_vehicles.name: Favela Culture
mutant_vehicles.description: The Favela Culture Mutant Vehicle is characterized by its skull-shaped design, symbolizing the universal truth that we are all equal beneath the surface. Regardless of differences in skin color, religion, sexual orientation or economic status, we are all united as human beings. Join us to dance and experience the vibrant culture of Brazil, brought to life and shared with the community of Black Rock City!

mutant_vehicles.name: Fertility Bed 10.1
mutant_vehicles.description: Its a Motorized Bed, very soft and fun

mutant_vehicles.name: Fins of fortune
mutant_vehicles.description:
Fins of Fortune is a koi-inspired art cart embodying the ancient legend of transformation through art, food, light, and performance. This steampunk-sculpted koi glows with animated LED scales that pulse in rhythm, telling the story of the fish who swam upstream, leapt the Dragon Gate, and became a dragon.

This is not a rideable vehicle, but a roaming immersive installation designed to spark joy and interaction. At its heart is a taiyaki station gifting koi-shaped treats and milk teas. Whimsical aviator fish-fin characters and interactive performers animate the space with playful movement and storytelling rooted in Asian symbolism.

mutant_vehicles.name: Fishtank
mutant_vehicles.description: The Fishtank..the lovable beast from the deep wellcomes all to come ride/chill or dance

mutant_vehicles.name: Fjörgyn
mutant_vehicles.description: The Fjorgyn is a 42 foot  Viking longboat with a crows nest and billowing multicolored sail. To look upon it will bring you back to the days of the original pirates of Nordic times.

mutant_vehicles.name: FL Man Fanboat
mutant_vehicles.description: The Florida Man Fanboat proudly glides across the playa rocking live music and sultry cuddle puddles to sunrise sets at the trash fence every night. A voyage supine, we bump funky beats and furry threads, ferrying you everywhere except Robot Heart.

mutant_vehicles.name: Flash
mutant_vehicles.description: Flash the tortoise is A radically modified gem car utilizing custom aluminum shell structure and backlit LED panels.

mutant_vehicles.name: Flash Gordon Rocket Ship
mutant_vehicles.description: For those old enough to remember the Flash Gordon TV series, This is a replica of the Rocket Ship.

mutant_vehicles.name: Flotilla
mutant_vehicles.description: Six wheeled retro 70s pontoon land yacht

mutant_vehicles.name: Fluffy
mutant_vehicles.description:
Fluffy is accessible public transit masquerading as a wafting cloud to elicit and excite your dreams. A wheelchair lift and Braille rails make a mutant vehicle experience
accessible to that many more Burners. Gifting forays provide iced liquid refreshment in
the heat of the day (Deep Playa Beer Delivery) and warm gooey treats in the chill of the
night (Smores). Come Fluffy with us.

mutant_vehicles.name: Fluffy
mutant_vehicles.description: Fluffy is a dual level fire breathing gargoyle, that is fully custom built mutant vehicle.

mutant_vehicles.name: Flux Capacitor
mutant_vehicles.description: Only stupid people would attempt to build a car like this. Or really dumb people. One of the two.

mutant_vehicles.name: Flying Pegasus
mutant_vehicles.description:
Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (For Fucked-up Flat-Foot)
Large Scale Wire Art Winged Pegasus Art Vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing Playa transportation and refreshments

mutant_vehicles.name: Fokaround
mutant_vehicles.description: A roaming illuminated lounge built on a transformed Truck Chassis, this Mutant Vehicle is designed as a mobile sanctuary on the playa. By day it offers an open air platform for rest and connection. By night it becomes a fully animated geometric light sculpture glowing in all directions. Guests are invited to cruise, pause, and share meaningful conversations in a welcoming space that blends art, movement, and community.

mutant_vehicles.name: For The Record
mutant_vehicles.description: For the Record is a gigantic record player and speakers, a living homage to physical media.

mutant_vehicles.name: Forest House
mutant_vehicles.description: The Forest House Art Car is a two-story mobile art piece featuring 30,000 LEDs and a Void Acoustics sound system. It offers an immersive experience with vibrant lighting and powerful audio, creating a dynamic space for exploration, music, and creative expression.

mutant_vehicles.name: Fortress of Solitude
mutant_vehicles.description: Superman's chariot of sound and visual delights.

mutant_vehicles.name: Fox Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Fox Art Car is a fully transformed electric vehicle reimagined as a glowing, geometric fox that roams the playa. Built from a welded steel frame and wrapped in repurposed sailcloth, it comes alive at night with color changing LEDs and deep green glowing eyes. Designed to be open and social, riders sit facing one another, creating space for connection, laughter, and shared experience. More than a vehicle, it is an interactive, moving sculpture that invites participation,
sparks curiosity, and brings playful, mischievous energy to the community.

mutant_vehicles.name: Franklin The Very Hungry Caterpillar
mutant_vehicles.description: The Hungry Caterpillar is an all-electric illuminated art vehicle based on Eric Carle's beloved children's book. It features inflatable segments form the caterpillar's body backlit by LEDs that breathe and pulse with color. Inside: plush teddy-bear fabric, lounge seating, and a second-floor DJ booth. Zero emissions, zero generators. In 2027, the caterpillar will become a butterfly.

mutant_vehicles.name: Funkadelephant
mutant_vehicles.description: The Funkadelephant is a wild wandering Party Pachyderm, an apex species native to the Black Rock Desert, born out of the waters of Lake Lahontan and riding from the Dust once each year to bring merry and delight to residents of Black Rock City

mutant_vehicles.name: Funklet
mutant_vehicles.description: Funklet is a cute little baby elephant, who likes chasing his ball across the desert, and running away from his mother, Funkadelephant, the big white elephant. If you see him on his own, please tell his mum where to find him!

mutant_vehicles.name: Fuzzy Bunny Head
mutant_vehicles.description: The Bunny is a Warm & Fuzzy, welcoming, soft, comfortable, place to meet new and wonderful strangers, while exploring Black Rock City and the unknown.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ganesh Express
mutant_vehicles.description: Ganesh Express blends the apocalyptic with the ascendant, bringing the playfulness of water misting and lights with the gritty aesthetic in a desert punk wasteland.

mutant_vehicles.name: Garden of Dreamin'
mutant_vehicles.description: The Garden of Dreamin' is a lush, otherworldly escape where reality bends and imagination blooms. Winding paths lead through surreal landscapes of lava flows, whispering fungi, and glowing plants that sway with the breeze. It's a sanctuary for wanderers, lovers, and late-night thinkers.  Hop on and find yourself in a place where time slows, stars feel closer, and dreams drift freely among the alien trees.

mutant_vehicles.name: Gema
mutant_vehicles.description: Be not afraid

mutant_vehicles.name: Ghost of The Lady Washington
mutant_vehicles.description: Born in the year 2008 of the "American Dream", the "Ghost of the Lady Washington" is brought to you by your friends at Northwest Mist - home port in the 3:00 - 4:30 (Berlin) sectors. She is a small but intricate playa taxi who specializes in seeing the sites in style with quiet conversational interactions. The silent running battery powered ship is a sailing pleasure cruise on ancient Lake Lahontan.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ghost Slipper
mutant_vehicles.description: This vehicle is shaped like an Alladins Slipper. It is usually wearing a blue dress, but can occasionally be out on the play on a silver one.  It is covered in over 1,000 individually addressable LED Lights and contains a very discrete 11 speaker Sound System.

mutant_vehicles.name: Giraffic Jam
mutant_vehicles.description: This Giraffe is not messing around. He learned that people think he is cute and cuddly and he has decided to change his image with fire!

mutant_vehicles.name: Giving Tree
mutant_vehicles.description: The Giving Tree art car brings a unique one of a kind immersive experience to the imagination of creation. She's a willow tree that stands 25 feet tall, 28 feet long, 24 feet wide. Her trunks base is 21 feet long, 8 feet wide. It's a unmutilated 1989 Blue Bird short bus tiny home that hides inside her trunk which makes for a very grounded mobile or stationary tree house on wheels. You can ascend up a 6 foot tree ladder through a hatch door that lets you access the upper rooftop party deck. In the center of the rooftop the trunk continues up with a 5 foot tree ladder to a crows nest also with safety railings. From the crows nest just under the top canopy of willow branches the views of any event are spectacular.

mutant_vehicles.name: Glorb the beignet max pro 2 too
mutant_vehicles.description: Glorb is a fully electric remote controlled art car designed to showcase the transition to an all electric sustainable future.  Don't try to listen or smell for Glorb's approach, because Glorb is silent with a delightful lack of gasoline fumes that are common on so many art cars.  Your ears and nose are no good here.  To find Glorb, you must use your eyes or your heart.  Look for a bright glowing cube at night, a holographic rainbow cube during the day, and follow the feeling of the vibes of love and friendship in your heart.

mutant_vehicles.name: Glorious Wet Spot
mutant_vehicles.description: The lighted oasis and fun spot for cruising the playa. Dance with us on the upper deck or chill out on the couches down below.

mutant_vehicles.name: GoCaBo
mutant_vehicles.description: A land lubbin' Playa Boat

mutant_vehicles.name: Golden Gate Dream
mutant_vehicles.description: GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE Inspired by the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, this mutant vehicle transforms a 2004 Blue Bird school bus into a rolling suspension bridge of light, sound, and community. By day, bold ship rope defines the bridge's unmistakable silhouette while providing shade and a gathering space for rest and connection. By night, red, white, and blue LED lighting and moving beams bring the structure to life across the playa. Traveling through the city and open desert, the bridge offers rides, music, and cold beverages to dusty travelers, welcoming all citizens of Black Rock City to cross, connect, and share the journey.

mutant_vehicles.name: Golden Mean
mutant_vehicles.description:
Golden Mean
The visually stunning vehicle takes its name from the golden ratio, a mathematical proportion that's said to produce aesthetically pleasing art and architecture. Other inspirations for the project include the Giant Pink Sea Snail from Doctor Doolittle, giant mechanical elephant puppets by Royal de Luxe and Jules Verne's imaginative creations.

mutant_vehicles.name: Gon KiRin
mutant_vehicles.description:
Gon KiRin (GKR)  is a light dragon sculpture that was conceived by Teddy Lo @teddylostudio, Ryan C Doyle @doylehuge 
& built by a collective of dragon artists.

mutant_vehicles.name: Gothic Dust
mutant_vehicles.description: The Gothic Carriage is a custom-built electric art vehicle designed to resemble a moving gothic architectural structure rather than a conventional car. Its tall silhouette, dark exterior finish, and sculptural details such as gargoyles and ornamental trim create the visual presence of a gliding carriage across the playa. The enclosed cabin accommodates up to four passengers, offering an intimate and immersive environment for shared interaction. Exterior profile lighting defines the vehicle's shape at night, enhancing visibility while preserving its dramatic outline. Designed for stable movement across soft terrain, the carriage functions both as a transport platform and a mobile interactive art installation for participant engagement.

mutant_vehicles.name: Gracie Sandbar
mutant_vehicles.description: A weary castaway's home away from home. A tropical beach shack providing supervised swim, sunbathing, volleyball and refreshments on the playa near you!

mutant_vehicles.name: Gramma Dorothy's Loveseat
mutant_vehicles.description: A cozy mobile loveseat to traverse the playa in the comforting vibe of a grandmother's living room. A place to knit, crochet, and relax among the loud and chaotic world around us.

mutant_vehicles.name: Grand Lind Voyager
mutant_vehicles.description: Grand Lind Voyager (In Estonian "lind" meaning "bird") is a mutant vehicle built by Estonian Burners. Like migrating birds, Estonians fly over the clouds to the Black Rock Desert. Almost every year, some since 2008.

mutant_vehicles.name: Grazzhopper
mutant_vehicles.description: Grazzhopper is a green hopping creature providing lounging fun and transportation to migrators of the playa - day and night.

mutant_vehicles.name: Great American Phoenix
mutant_vehicles.description: Come join us in the nest of the Great American Phoenix! It's sure to be a bright and exciting time to soar across the playa together.

mutant_vehicles.name: Great Sax
mutant_vehicles.description: Great Sax is an artist's representation (NOT an exact depiction) of a large scale mobile Saxophone from a concept by professional Saxman, Rick Metz (Navigator RICK). It's equipped with a small, high quality sound system for playing recorded and live music. It's radically illuminated so that it's highly visible at night. It made its debut at BM 2023.

mutant_vehicles.name: Grit and Gold
mutant_vehicles.description: Grit and Gold is an electric art car inspired by a traditional Hong Kong junk boat, reimagined for the playa. Designed to embody resilience, creativity, and connection, it offers a mobile gathering space for friends and fellow burners. At night, blue underglow lights mimic movement over water, while RGB lighting, mandalas, and UV-reactive artwork bring it to life. A built-in sound system sets the vibe, and the crew serves cold chai and matcha to spark moments of joy. In the spirit of Tomorrow Today, Grit and Gold invites the community to dream, dance, and build the future together.

mutant_vehicles.name: Gypsy Kitty
mutant_vehicles.description: Gypsy Playa Raver Kitty is our Green mythical magical playa kitty that is out spreading love and rainbow colored magic.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ha-Ha-Ha Harvey
mutant_vehicles.description:
Reclaimed 1970 Glastron Speedboat hull mounted on a reclaimed 1994 G5 Yamaha Golf Cart Chassis. Painted ocean
wave skirts, seating for 12 people, bike racks, LED light strings throughout including up the mast with white strobes on
top, groovy sound system, shade Bimini Top, sounding bell, plus a buckled reclaimed kayak that appears smashed on
the bow. Hop aboard, matey!

mutant_vehicles.name: HAL: Lunar Rover-Redux
mutant_vehicles.description:
HAL 2.0: Lunar Rover is a 70's Retro concept inspired by Stanley Kubrick's 2001 A Space Odyssey and Irwin Allen's
Lost in Space.

mutant_vehicles.name: Hanuman Ji
mutant_vehicles.description: A pentagonal prism art car with parametric face panels of the five faced form of Hanuman (Panchamukhi Hanuman). The "crown" panels on top are CNC cut panels in design stylings of Hindu deity crowns.

mutant_vehicles.name: Harriet the Hippo-MOOP-potamus
mutant_vehicles.description:
Meet Harriett the Hippo-MOOP-potamus—part majestic mutant vehicle, part relentless MOOP-enforcer, and 100% here to keep Black Rock City clean (with a side of sass). Inspired by Hungry Hungry Hippos, she's an offensively pink two-seater, battery-powered party hippo, rolling through the dust with giant googly eyes, LED bling, and a mission: Leave No Trace or feel her judgy hippo stare.

Harriett doesn't just give joyrides—she guilt-trips Burners into picking up trash. See some stray MOOP? Scoop it up like your Playa cred depends on it (because it does). Hop on, grab a ride, and let's keep this desert spotless—Harriett is watching. 👀

mutant_vehicles.name: Heavy Meta
mutant_vehicles.description: Heavy Meta is a terrifying, hand-cut sheet metal-clad fire-breathing dragon. Featuring interactive flame, sound and light effects, Heavy Meta can accommodate up to 30 people, and will be traversing the open playa day and night.

mutant_vehicles.name: Heavy Petting Zoo
mutant_vehicles.description: Heavy Petting Zoo's main purpose is to create community while providing spontaneous opportunities for fun and inclusion for all species of party animals.

mutant_vehicles.name: Hel's Diner
mutant_vehicles.description: Hel's Diner is that Art Car with the two tall red towers that has food, a bar and music.

mutant_vehicles.name: Helga
mutant_vehicles.description: Helga the Viking Ship

mutant_vehicles.name: Helios
mutant_vehicles.description: Helios serves as a reminder of what it means to be human. In this age of technology, we need to keep our connection with nature. Life is beautiful.

mutant_vehicles.name: HELLIBUS jr
mutant_vehicles.description: Helibus is a nod to the absurd. We/us believe that if you can imagine it you can make it. We are a crew of dreamers and athletes who love serving up good food at least once a burn and solid beats and playful vibes the rest of the time. We have cold treats and all the sports at all times. Our bus is your bus so get in z choopa and let’s roll

mutant_vehicles.name: Hello Yellow Towing and Floating Crap Game
mutant_vehicles.description: Work or fun, Hello Yellow's the one!

mutant_vehicles.name: HEPA Filter
mutant_vehicles.description: The Hardly Effective Playa Anti-dust aka HEPA Filter is a whimsically ineffective device for keeping Black Rock City free of dust while providing rides for lots of burners

mutant_vehicles.name: Hermes
mutant_vehicles.description: "An 18-foot articulated kinetic sculpture atop a modified Isuzu chassis, Hermes features a weathered steel exoskeleton, integrated LED arrays, and a Greco-Roman helmet plumage that serves as a mobile pillar for the Axis Mundi."

mutant_vehicles.name: Horse
mutant_vehicles.description: Horse was adopted from the BLM pens in Spanish Springs, Nevada.  She has returned to her homeland range in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. A gentle soul she is, but she can also buck the most robust of cowboys.  Horse is typically happy to help weary travelers to their destination. She can often be found checking the fencelines at BRC, and is always looking for fellow horses to gallop across the range with.

mutant_vehicles.name: Hsssisss - the Baby Sea Dragon
mutant_vehicles.description: Hssiss - the Baby Sea serpent Dragon is the love child of Abraxas the golden dragon that has been roaming the playa since 2006. She is a zippy little dragon that loves to roam the outer playa finding play mates to pick up and go on adventures with. She loves good music and sunrises and long drives on the playa. she is a shinny beautiful creature that comes when called and  will do tricks for love. She tends to stick close to her mum (when her mum is in fine form) and likes to cast shade and bring beverages and snacks to the wandering folk of black rock city.

mutant_vehicles.name: Human Heart
mutant_vehicles.description: Human Heart is a visual pun on Robot Heart that plays primarily acoustic music

mutant_vehicles.name: Humble Be
mutant_vehicles.description:
To build our art car we decided to use a recycled, crashed, fully electric Nissan Leaf as the base car. We have striped
apart the car, leaving the interior half, motor, battery system, and other elements necessary to leave the art car
operational and high voltage safe and secure to drive on the Playa. 
The "sculpture" have been elevated and braced six feet over the platform with vertical supports
enough to stabilize the piece during its ride and to possible high winds/storms at the Playa.
The platform and the sculpture is well-illuminated with yellow/orange/gold LED lights in different shapes.
We have 3 low-pressure steady flames (one in each antenna and a third one in the sting) fueled by propane tanks
placed inside the platform.

mutant_vehicles.name: Humblebee
mutant_vehicles.description: Humblebee is a polygonal adaptation of Bumblebee.  The wings will unfold on deep playa and the legs will move while driving.

mutant_vehicles.name: HunDroid
mutant_vehicles.description: Hungarian assisted self driving Mooncar

mutant_vehicles.name: Hygge
mutant_vehicles.description: Cloud Opera engaging senses through comfort and sound healing

mutant_vehicles.name: I Think I Can
mutant_vehicles.description: I Think I Can - tugboat—a whimsical vessel cruising the playa, complete with nautical details and fun crew onboard!

mutant_vehicles.name: Immortal
mutant_vehicles.description: Immortal is a glowing jellyfish art car, built in honor and to highlight the resilience and rebirth of the remarkable Turritopsis dohrnii (immortal jellyfish).

mutant_vehicles.name: Immortal Wolf
mutant_vehicles.description: The spirit of the immortal wolf lives inside us all. Let your inner wolf roar at the universe and forever spiral out.

mutant_vehicles.name: Infini-Tea Spot
mutant_vehicles.description:
As the Infini-Tea Spot drifts through the night, her shimmering skin is awash in a delicious rainbow glow and pulsing with the life of the Playa. Through loving intent, she becomes a living sculpture, caressing the playa and beckoning. Welcoming you inside the velvety jewel box you'll find an invitation to ceremony, offering warmth, sweetness, and nourishment in the form of late-night tea and cookies. No, expectations here, only the sweet joy of sharing and the magic of the moment.   
 This Infini-Tea Spot pours the spirit of connection, the nourishment of creation, and the warmth of community in motion. Here, we offer a space where the magic of stories unfold, and every sweet soul is welcome, just as they are.

mutant_vehicles.name: Iron Butterfly
mutant_vehicles.description: A giant butterfly of bright fabric and aluminum. During the day, an oasis with lots of shade and cold beverages. At night, chill and dreamy rides.

mutant_vehicles.name: Irony
mutant_vehicles.description:
At a time like this, scorching irony, not convincing argument, is needed.” - Frederick Douglass
Don’t be fooled by her rusty sheet iron patina or cargo of pickled convicts. This car is the hardest working appliance at the Burn (incl handhelds!) and its owners might also argue, the most beautiful. Rusty panels cover her like battle scars of Burns gone by... Some won... more lost.. but ironing out the creases of the Black Rock City playa is a full-time and often thankless task that this “Lil engine that could", has continued to dust herself off and embrace since 2014. She often idles but rarely sleeps. Not always the first car to arrive, but usually the last to leave. This MV is a rattling, coughing, stalling reminder that, the "ugly ones" always work harder for it, as the 1,000’s of Burners that have enjoyed a ride in her red velvet interior will attest. To quote Ron Jeremy “Quantity has a quality all of its own!” Viva la Irony!

mutant_vehicles.name: Ivory Tower
mutant_vehicles.description: The  ivory tower glistening rises from the desert. A curved hyperboloid tower from which to see the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Jaguar Nap
mutant_vehicles.description: Jaguar Nap is there when you're tired, but want to be at the party: An immersive mobile bedtime experience includes an opulent bed traveling on a lithe Jaguar, with hot chocolate, bedtime stories and lingerie, disco ball included.

mutant_vehicles.name: Jealousy the Bear
mutant_vehicles.description: Comparison is the death of joy, and Jealousy is a real bear.

mutant_vehicles.name: Jeffrey the Furry Helicopter
mutant_vehicles.description: The Jeffrey is the fun fuzzy and furry Helicopter

mutant_vehicles.name: Jelly Fish Hexacycle
mutant_vehicles.description: A jelly fish shaped, 6-wheeled, pedal and electric powered vehicle that can transport people above, and temporarily engulf walkers and bikers below, bathing them with its mesmerizing tentacles & cooling mist!

mutant_vehicles.name: Jolly the incredibly annouying chimp II
mutant_vehicles.description: The creepy chimp clapping cymbals we have all grown to Love or Hate that is always on playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Joyism
mutant_vehicles.description: Experience Joyism in all its forms as the yellow canopied Joyism artcar glides by.

mutant_vehicles.name: Kevin
mutant_vehicles.description: 'Kevin' One Of The Most Beloved Small Art Cars On The Playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Kinderpanzer
mutant_vehicles.description: Kinderpanzer is an apocalypse inspired armored tank paying tribute to the early days of Burning Man before Black Rock City had streets. The shell is made of entirely recycled aluminum and steel, built in 2017 by the K-Rats. Project lead artist & fabrication: Lynn Bryant, design & detailing: Kimric Smythe & Walter Petelle (K-Rats)

mutant_vehicles.name: King
mutant_vehicles.description:
Multi-story knights armor helmet. King provides a viewing platform for Burners to
experience the Playa from a height of 15'+ above ground level.

mutant_vehicles.name: Kissy Fish
mutant_vehicles.description: A sparkling, walking fish covered with holographic scales with giant moving red lips, big kinetic legs that crawling along the playa, and pairs of waving fins and tails

mutant_vehicles.name: Kokomotive
mutant_vehicles.description: KokoMotive is a  Steam Punk themed, Locomotive featuring Dance Platform and a flying saucer atop the cage on back of vehicle.

mutant_vehicles.name: Kwalq Bus (formerly known as Thataway Bus)
mutant_vehicles.description: The Kwalq Bus is here to transform your experience, pointing the way with a simple, giant, neon frog directing you to new adventures.

mutant_vehicles.name: L'Atelier de Wagon
mutant_vehicles.description: L'Atelier de Wagon has been created solely for the intent of interaction, participation, leave no trace, and gifting at Burning Man.The vehicle is a mobile art studio, bringing together professional and amateur artists or anyone whom wants to give painting a shot. Atelier gives the ability to participants to share their feelings, emotions, thoughts, and minds through live, group, artwork creation. Participants can paint in one location, load into the vehicle, be comfortable during a journey, then unload and continue to work in a new location creating a whole new set of outside interaction in which to paint.

mutant_vehicles.name: La Catrina
mutant_vehicles.description: La Catrina represents a Mexican holiday tradition that is celebrated on Nov 1and Nov 2, on these days we remember and honor our deceased loved ones, it is believe that their spirit returns and visits their families. Families build ofrendas {altars} with marigolds, candles, photos and food to guide their spirits.

mutant_vehicles.name: La Playa Familia
mutant_vehicles.description: La Playa Familia is an art car inspired by the breathtaking beauty of La Sagrada Familia and the spirit of human connection. Just as the Playa brings together people from around the world to share, create, and connect, Familia offers a space where everyone feels welcome—a moving sanctuary of belonging, unity, and shared experience.

mutant_vehicles.name: La Rana Hypnótica
mutant_vehicles.description: A hypnotic and colorful frog who glides around the Playa offering rides to dusty burners. You'll be mesmerized by his changing colors and dapper appearance.

mutant_vehicles.name: La Tortuga
mutant_vehicles.description: La Tortuga is the slowest artcar on the playa. We promote speed limits and slow cruising. Hop on and share the moment with us.

mutant_vehicles.name: Lady Whiskey (aka "Chooch")
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Lady Whiskey, lovingly called “the Chooch” was originally built for Burning Man in 2011, and has evolved through the work of dedicated west coast elves.

She's a 30-foot rusty faux steam locomotive. The concept was inspired by a train graveyard in Bolivia, and originally brought to life by Paul Haugland, Molly Murphy, Philip Beber, Jessica Jensen, Brandon Lortz, Thom Orth, and many others. From Seattle to Oakland, our lovely lady now resides in Vallejo, CA.

mutant_vehicles.name: Large Marge The Great Pumpkin
mutant_vehicles.description: Large Marge is a spooky carved pumpkin thats comfortable, with lots of lights Halloween decor and candy, trick or treat

mutant_vehicles.name: LemonCraft
mutant_vehicles.description: Delivering almost ice-cold lemonade to Participants on the Playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Lemons Into Lemonade
mutant_vehicles.description: A small scale, electric art car, cruising the playa dispensing advice and rides and helping folks realize their lemons can be lemonade

mutant_vehicles.name: Lepi Duo
mutant_vehicles.description: A larger than life Butterfly that 4 people can ride on the back of while cruising the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Lepi, The Butterfly
mutant_vehicles.description:
A cross between a real butterfly and a steampunk metal robot butterfly that you can ride on the back of. 
this is a complete custom build that is built out of new go kart wheels, suspension. 
A custom welded frame with a 6hp gas motor with a belt and chain drive. 
all metal construction painted in steampunk colors 
the ability to disassemble the vehicle for transportation was a must. 
the tail will also be lit up and will wag from side to side. 
a balance between looking cool during the day and night will be struct

mutant_vehicles.name: LifeCar
mutant_vehicles.description: LifeCar is a scaled version of the 1964 game piece from The Game of Life built by Shawn Lusebrink and Gary Sutherland.

mutant_vehicles.name: Light Party'cle
mutant_vehicles.description: What happens if you caught up with particle of light? This question, posed by a 16-year-old Einstein, is the inspiration behind our mutant vehicle, "Party'cle of Light." Hop in Einstein!

mutant_vehicles.name: Lil Warrior
mutant_vehicles.description: Lil Warrior, a tribute to OG Mayan Warrior

mutant_vehicles.name: Lil' Playa Plane
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Lil' Playa Plane was created to bring out the Lil' People in all of us. It is designed to bring back the memories of childhood,
when we were all fascinated with the simplest of interactions. Sounds, Lights, and Fun Simple Songs. Whether watching it drive by or jumping aboard the Lil' Playa Plane brings smiles and nostalgia from everyone who comes in contact with it. The Lil' Playa Plane is loved by everyone and still has the unofficial title as the "cutest"
art car on the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: LilyPod
mutant_vehicles.description: Lilypad - most comfortable way to float upon the playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Little Bleu
mutant_vehicles.description: Little Bleu is a feisty galaxy frigate born for adventure.  Her compact form ready to whisk you away on a journey of artistic discovery. By day, this sleek marvel acts as your personal oasis, keeping you cooled and refreshed as her advanced electrics quietly whisk you from one art marvel to the next. A network of  integrated solar panels, like shimmering scales, drink in the daylight, powering her silent grace. But when twilight descends, She truly awakens. Her daytime elegance transforms into a breathtaking spectacle of light. Intricate neon stylings, trace the lines of her chassis that erupt in a dazzling array of cosmic hues – electric blues, vibrant purples, and fiery oranges dance and intertwine, creating an intergalactic aura.

mutant_vehicles.name: Little Red Rocket
mutant_vehicles.description:
There's something about changing an objects history or its inherent value that I find interesting. I like to invite viewers to re think the way an object is used by giving new life to the discarded, but also who I am as a person who always trys to do more with less.
The Little Red Rocket carries the same idea. Besides some of the lighting no new materials were purchased for the direct build of this MV. Everything was resourced from reclaimed wood, personal items I wasn't using all that much, and left over art supplies. I collect a lot of things so when I go to create I have something to start with. Everything I had happen to be red and then..it just built itself.

mutant_vehicles.name: Log Ride
mutant_vehicles.description: Its log, its log, its big, its heavy, its wood.... Its log, its log, its better than bad, its good.

mutant_vehicles.name: Lola Montez Saloon
mutant_vehicles.description: A cozy, old west saloon serving up spirits and spirited conversation.

mutant_vehicles.name: Love Blossom
mutant_vehicles.description: Love Blossom helps love, connection and compassion bloom on the playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Lucky Fucky Ducky
mutant_vehicles.description:
Once upon a splash, there lived a duck who was too big for the bathtub.
He was a trickster at heart, always stirring up
mischief, charming the flock, and dreaming of
golden horizons. Some say he's looking for trouble.
Others say he's running from bubbles.
Either way, if you see him driving by,
feathers gleaming gold, his
daring soul shining through
the stripper pole, jump on
and take a spin.

mutant_vehicles.name: Lucy EsCarGo
mutant_vehicles.description: Presented by Preservation Society, Lucy EsCarGo is Black Rock City’s premier disco snail. She’s slow, she’s saucy, and she firmly believes LED rainbow shells are the new black. Catch her shimmering across the playa at a deeply unhurried pace, climb aboard, and discover the joy of arriving fashionably — eventually.

mutant_vehicles.name: Luminary
mutant_vehicles.description: Luminary - golden ratio based pyramid car and sound bath

mutant_vehicles.name: Magic Shoe Bus Ride
mutant_vehicles.description: Come take a ride on the Magic Shoe Bus  - come kick it with us

mutant_vehicles.name: Magnolia Thunderpussy
mutant_vehicles.description: Magnolia Thunderpussy, the mutant vehicle is a copper colored 21 foot Pangolin, based on an endangered species from Africa and China. She is made from over 800 hand cut steel scales.

mutant_vehicles.name: Matsya
mutant_vehicles.description: Matsya is a sacred golden fish rising from the playa the way a creature rises from the deep, unhurried and luminous, as if the desert has always been her ocean. Named for Vishnu's first avatar, the fish who carried light and knowledge into a new age, she travels the Axis Mundi of Black Rock City connecting worlds and strangers. By day a bold yellow sculpted form with dramatic red lips and swept fins. By night a full body lantern glowing from within across the open playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: MAXA
mutant_vehicles.description: Despite centuries of outside influence, the Huichol people have preserved their shamanic traditions and spiritual connection to nature. In their worldview, the search for higher knowledge is seen as a sacred journey guided by the Blue Deer, known as Kauyumari. The MAXA vehicle is inspired by this powerful symbol, featuring extended antlers at the front and interactive elements such as side swings. Designed to host up to 50 participants, the vehicle welcomes all who wish to experience its spirit of exploration. At night, performers inspired by Huichol traditions will share warm beverages and moments of comfort, evoking the timeless journey of seeking wisdom and inner discovery.

mutant_vehicles.name: Melton John
mutant_vehicles.description: Melton is a double decker mobile piano lounge featuring live music.

mutant_vehicles.name: Mirrorcore
mutant_vehicles.description: Mirrorcore is a reflective, futuristic sculpture on wheels—an immersive mutant vehicle crafted from a 2019 Ford Transit van and transformed with hand-shaped stainless steel and mirrored chrome elements. Designed by Luna Prysiazhniuk to mirror the beauty of the Playa and its people, it shifts throughout the day, capturing light, sky, dust, and movement. By night, it comes alive with dynamic LED lighting, becoming a glowing prism of motion and color. With a rooftop platform, interactive design, and custom bike trailer, Mirrorcore invites participants to climb aboard, connect, and ride into the surreal—reflecting the collective spirit of Black Rock City.

mutant_vehicles.name: Mix Tape (aka White Lightening)
mutant_vehicles.description:
Mix Tape is a drivable to scale classic cassette.  We encourage interaction through our selection of "choose your own tape" by allowing our audience to choose a custom playlist via cassette.  Pick and play.  
Stand with our DJ's, enjoy snacks and drinks on the playa as you bathe in dance music. Get a memory photo record.

mutant_vehicles.name: Moby- The Rainbow Fish
mutant_vehicles.description: A vibrant, LED-lit mutant vehicle shaped like a rainbow fish, with glowing scales and whimsical, flowing fins, creating a mesmerizing, colorful spectacle embodying the principles of generosity, connection, and celebration of uniqueness.

mutant_vehicles.name: Moebius Omnibus
mutant_vehicles.description: An 8' round omnidirectional "flying saucer" morphed into a comfy couch with umbrella for about 12 participants to interact on.

mutant_vehicles.name: Monaco
mutant_vehicles.description: A square rigged 1/2 scale replica frigate ship that actually sails under wind power whenever possible, the world’s largest landsailer, and we are not pirates…

mutant_vehicles.name: Monstrosity
mutant_vehicles.description: Monstrosity is a steampunk-era peace keeping vehicle used to transport passengers into new time dimensions. Its artistic design, details, and lighting will astound and inspire

mutant_vehicles.name: MooMooMobile
mutant_vehicles.description: Sir Loin the MooMooMobile is a cute cow. Come ring our cowbells!

mutant_vehicles.name: Moon Child Océanique
mutant_vehicles.description:
A cozy illuminated crescent moon cradle floating on the dried up Lake Lahontan honoring the Pacific Ocean and the majestic Dolphin, Shark and Turtle.

@moon_child_oceanique

mutant_vehicles.name: Moonbuggy
mutant_vehicles.description: Moonbuggy is a rising crescent moon that glows as bright as the celestial orb in the sky. Her plush white interior quarters cocoon you from the elements, as a disco ball projects an astral landscape onto the surrounding playa. Come cruise the galaxy with us!

mutant_vehicles.name: Moopba Roomba Cat
mutant_vehicles.description: Moopba. A large roomba cat riding on a robot vacuum.

mutant_vehicles.name: Mudpuppy
mutant_vehicles.description: A pixelated Proteidae emerges from the block biome to hypnotize humanity with a bio-luminescent display of diodes

mutant_vehicles.name: Mush: The Magic Myco Mobile
mutant_vehicles.description: This magical field of mushrooms lofts above its turtle's back waiting to shade you and take you on a trip to see the wonders the burn has to offer.

mutant_vehicles.name: Mystic Flyer Experience
mutant_vehicles.hometown: Cyberius Rex is from Ohio.  The Flyer winters in Las Vegas where Mystic Arts Foundation intends to establish a permanent co-op artist facility to house and maintain and teach others how to collaborate on creating large-scale, transformational art.
mutant_vehicles.description:
Award-Winning Mystic Flyer Experience is an art-centric MV designed to showcase beautiful art & technology through stunning visuals & interactivity. Since 2016, Black Rock City citizens report transformational experiences via our Optical Illusion LED Prism Panels, discovering evening DJ sets, listening to the Consciousness Time Travel Audio Journey, or taking in Playa art from our Roof Deck's vantage point. We will continue gifting this mutant vehicle in 2026 and beyond, adding new artists' work and technologies as funding permits for many years to come.

With love & stardust,
Cyberius Rex, Flyte Attendants, Mystic camp, & Mystic Arts Foundation

mutant_vehicles.name: NeoTrek
mutant_vehicles.description: NeoTrek is the little Choo Choo that could.

mutant_vehicles.name: Nice A Roli
mutant_vehicles.description: Nice A Roli is an all Electric SF Cable Car offering good vibes and fun rides to burners.

mutant_vehicles.name: NumbSkull
mutant_vehicles.description: Uncle Sam skull car with rainbow led lights.

mutant_vehicles.name: Odo Duo
mutant_vehicles.description: A larger than life robotic dragonfly that can fit up to 4 people.

mutant_vehicles.name: Odo the Dragonfly
mutant_vehicles.description: A larger than life Dragon fly that 4 people can ride on the back of while cruising the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Odo Tre, The Dragonfly
mutant_vehicles.description: A larger than life Dragonfly that 4 people can ride on the back of while cruising the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ohmu of the Valley of the WInd
mutant_vehicles.description: Ohmu is a sentient pillbug-like creature that's very strong yet sensitive. They have green shells and 14 eyes that are usually blue but can turn red when they've been angered. Ohmu were a race of large terrestrial arthropods that formed on Earth following the Seven Days of Fire that engulfed the planet which transformed much of the surface into the hostile Cursed Earth. The Ohmu were one of many creatures that the previous humans had created in order to purify their polluted world. As Ohmu traverses the Playa, it cleans up any MOOP, embodying the leave no trace principle and to help purify the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: One-Eyed Monster Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: The One-Eyed Monster Art Car (OEM) is a vision, as with the design and builder of Stone Larkin. His vision of the One-Eyed Monster is the male creative force seeking a place to plant, inseminate, and create. The One-Eyed Monster Car is a physical manifestation of this energy. One that has manifested itself on the playa since 2013, and with each passing year, this manifestation only grows stronger! Since 2019, a new team has learned to tame the OEM.

mutant_vehicles.name: Onward
mutant_vehicles.description: A Seahorse, piloting a team of Dolphins, on a Tsunami Wave

mutant_vehicles.name: Pacific
mutant_vehicles.description: Pacific is designed and themed in the form of Neptune's Chariot/ It's 22 feet long, 7 feet wide, and 20 feet tall in the front section and is fashioned out of welded steel and adorned with art representing Neptune's colorful world. Pacific is pulled by four 8-foot tall seahorses and covered with colorful lights and is accompanied by dolphins and a 12ft wide manta ray. Neptune drives the chariot.

mutant_vehicles.name: Passion Flower
mutant_vehicles.description: The Passion Flower marries kinetic, visual, and auditory elements in a multi-sensory experience of music. It is equipped with visceral and visionary artificial intelligence, 360-degree sound, and interactive lighting wrapped in blooming layers of dichroic film, Passion Flower reflects the beauty of its surroundings during the day and emits no exhaust or pollution. At night, its colorful LEDs take over, using lidar technology to automatically match the motion of the crowd and the energy of the music.

mutant_vehicles.name: Peacekeeper
mutant_vehicles.description: A holographic peace sign on wheels symbolizing peace rising as the sun of a new dawn, Peacekeeper is a soft-glowing, cloud-flanked sanctuary where anyone can climb through the symbol and find their center.

mutant_vehicles.name: Petabyte
mutant_vehicles.description: Consisting of over a million fiber optics and contributions from many of our brilliantly talented friends, Petabyte is BYTE's most collaborative and extraordinary expression of light, sound and tactility yet!

mutant_vehicles.name: Peter Panda
mutant_vehicles.description: Peter Panda is a small Mutant Vehicle that was conceived as a mode of transportation that will be enjoyable for all that ride on it.

mutant_vehicles.name: Pier Pressure
mutant_vehicles.description: Stop by our roving Pier for a swim or a suntan. No Pressure.

mutant_vehicles.name: Pillow Talk
mutant_vehicles.description: A rolling gold and red ornate bed experience connecting burners.

mutant_vehicles.name: Pingüina
mutant_vehicles.description:
As I waddle and slide across Black Rock City, I scatter sparks of presence, love, and joy through the dusty wake behind me. With a glowing heart and wandering flippers, I come to play, to dance beneath the stars, and help facilitate moments of wonder. Grateful for the chance to share this wild, fleeting life with you. Until we meet…
With love, Pingüina"

mutant_vehicles.name: Pink Aditi
mutant_vehicles.description: The Pink Aditi is an old styled buggy, like the one Dracula used to transport his coffin, but this one, was hit with the wand of an excitable fairy princess. With pink LED net curtains floating hundreds of pink LEDs behind the driver, pink fur seats, lots of pillows and blankets in the lounge-tub, offset by the clean hard lines of the raw steel Madd Max body. She's meant to inspire joy, wonder, to make a bubble of theater in the midst of all the spectacle. Sexy, stylish and silly all at the same time. It looks like a cartoon. It is plush and soft up front. It is lit up wildly with lights of all sorts, and the flaming flowers have a poofer to excite fire enthusiasts everywhere.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playa Del Soul
mutant_vehicles.description: Playa Del Soul is an Oasis on the playa. A giant Beach Lounge Chair for the masses. Hop on up and get a ride or just enjoy the padded daytime shade or vibrant night time light show.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playa Piano Bar and Airport Shuttle
mutant_vehicles.description: Dueling piano bar and lounge that travels 8 feet above the playa, but stops for performances rising 20 ft above the playa with live music!

mutant_vehicles.name: Playa Pizza Portage
mutant_vehicles.description: The Playa Pizza Portage is a happy and bright little slice, traveling the Playa, to bring joy and sustenance to adventurers anywhere they find us.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playa Predator
mutant_vehicles.description:
A friendly little shark car with a voracious appetite for pleasing people. The flame system
provides a unique elevated flame pit that is a beacon at night.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playa Trolly / Fun House
mutant_vehicles.description: Experience the Playa Trolley / Fun House, a mobile party with a stunning display of lights and music that will immerse you in the heart of Burning Man. Whether inside or outside, this rolling work of art will keep you entertained as the Playa comes alive around you.

mutant_vehicles.name: PlayaBoot
mutant_vehicles.description: Just like any cowboy, we're dedicated to serving all those who journey across the playa, no matter the challenges.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playacuda
mutant_vehicles.description: Playacuda is a socially immersive, friendly fish ready to have you join in the fun as we drive around the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Playatech Flaming Castle
mutant_vehicles.description: The Playatech Flaming Castle presents as smoldering 20'x12'x12' castle, made of Playatech slotted plywood parts with plush royal red décor and flame-like lighting, over a bronze-colored steel framework and armature, which are welded over a chopped '91 Volvo 240 sedan that is completely hidden except windshield and front side windows. By night, The Castle's bright red tower can be seen across the playa, while closer in it offers a subtle welcoming fire-like lighting experience.

mutant_vehicles.name: POLARIS
mutant_vehicles.description: Polaris is the North Star, the guiding star that takes you to your destination. And then... brings you back home - back to Playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Porch Swing
mutant_vehicles.description: Wooden bench swing on a porch on wheels.

mutant_vehicles.name: PPP Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: The Playa Peace Project is here to keep the peace! Come cruise with us as we rescue curious burners in deep playa, support art projects with our music and lights, and relax upstairs in our Hat Lounge and Cuddle Deck!

mutant_vehicles.name: Prism Heron
mutant_vehicles.description: Prism Heron is a faceted metallic bird mutant vehicle: part heron, part prism, part roving light sculpture. Built on a medium-duty truck platform, it carries an angular raised bird head, glowing triangular body panels, a wing-like canopy, and a small rider/music deck. By day it reflects the playa; by night its feather lines illuminate into a copper desert creature moving slowly through Black Rock City.

mutant_vehicles.name: Prodigal Swan
mutant_vehicles.description: Prodigal Swan is an interactive art car designed to evoke wonder and connection. With illuminated wings and a dramatic flame effect, it offers a visually stunning experience. More than just a vehicle, it's a moving piece of art that invites engagement and fosters community.

mutant_vehicles.name: Professor Pigeon
mutant_vehicles.description: Professor Pigeon invites you to travel on their galactic voyage, visiting strange new artwork, and badly going where on pigeon has gone before. Allow yourself to be whisked across the playa in style, to destinations unknown.

mutant_vehicles.name: Proto
mutant_vehicles.description: Proto is a steam punk inspired, fire breathing dragonfly time machine that is named after the extinct order of gigantic dragonfly's known as Protodonata. We offer rides to everyone-please ask when you see us!

mutant_vehicles.name: Pumablanco
mutant_vehicles.description: Pumablanco is an all white, furry, rolling mattress during the day...transforming to a psychedelic light show at night.

mutant_vehicles.name: Purple Panther
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Purple Panther is a bold, geometric mutant vehicle channeling the power, grace, and mystery of its feline
namesake. With a sharply sculpted silhouette, glowing LED patterns, and a commanding presence, it embodies both
strength and femininity. This sleek, two-level art car is designed to prowl the Playa with intention—inviting awe,
connection, and a sense of quiet power wherever it goes.

mutant_vehicles.name: Pyramid
mutant_vehicles.description: The Pyramid is a mobile pyramid, with large flame effects, lit from within.

mutant_vehicles.name: Pyramix
mutant_vehicles.description: 30 ft wide , 30 ft tall, three level, three-sided Pyramid car

mutant_vehicles.name: Pyrobar
mutant_vehicles.description: The Pyrobar is a classically-styled Bohemian Gem bringing it's unique experience to the Playa since 2004 and whether it's a warm greeting or sassy party, this fiery relic heats up the soul before dousing it with a healthy dose of firewater.

mutant_vehicles.name: Queen Celestine
mutant_vehicles.description: Dive into the magic of our Celestine Mutant Vehicle, a spectacular fusion of imagination and engineering based on the reliable Yamaha DRIVE Concierge G. By day, it's an enchanting mouse-like masterpiece with a soft, fur-like exterior and whimsically realistic features. As dusk falls, the Celestine comes alive with a symphony of LED lights that outline its form, casting an ethereal glow on the playa. Its illuminated claws hint at playful mischief, while the eyes, nose, and teeth double as innovative headlamps that guide the way through the nocturnal revelry. This mutant vehicle isn't just a mode of transportation; it's a moving installation that captures the spirit of creativity and community, becoming a beacon of tapestry of art.

mutant_vehicles.name: Queen of the Galaxy
mutant_vehicles.description: The Queen of the Galaxy is a mobile light show (tunnel of lights) with a Barbarella theme (think mirrored tiles with pink and white fur).

mutant_vehicles.name: Quesadilla Armadilla
mutant_vehicles.description: The Quesadilla Armadilla celebrates life with love of stories and food, the way my dad did. We remember him with this piece and remind everyone with whom we interact, to be present in this moment and enjoy it with the people you are with. This moment will soon be gone, but another will appear. Savor the moments you are fortunate enough to share with those you love.

mutant_vehicles.name: Raclette One
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Raclette One is a Swiss-Themed Spacecraft

As we all know - Switzerland is famous for cheese. What is mostly unknown is that Swiss cheese is harvested on the Moon by Astronaut Farmers. This year - we will bring our flagship - The Raclette one - to the playa. Our goal is to educate people about the origin of cheese and give out cheesy samples to dusty travelers.

mutant_vehicles.name: Radiolarian
mutant_vehicles.description: Radiolarian is a single cell organism mutated electric vehicle born in BRC and carrying up to 10 human organisms.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ray
mutant_vehicles.description: Ray, the Friendly aluminum skinned cart sized Manta Ray

mutant_vehicles.name: Re-In-Karma
mutant_vehicles.description:
Re-in-Karma is the stunning, double-decker beauty — now very familiar to long-time Burners. She is immediately recognizable when you see the shimmering pink wonder cruising by with a warm lie-down lower lounge and a high upper level viewing platform.
Re-in-Karma has an especially wide-open design that offers a wonderful invitation to passing pedestrian Burners. She is often seen carrying the marvelous band from Playa Jazz Cafe to entertain at special events on the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Ready Go Train Tours
mutant_vehicles.description:
Ready Go Black Rock City Train Tours!

Since 1907 we have been giving purely information tours around BRC and we are the only Tour LLC with licensing to legally operate according to the BMOrg Tour Inspection Committee.

Learn all about the history of Burning Man, from it's initial incarnation as Larry Harvey's eighth birthday party to the sprawling metropolis it is today!

Get to see art that regular BRC citizens haven't heard of, and even get a chance to ride the hidden subterranean tunnels that connect the 3 and 6 o'clock plaza, only on the Ready Go Black Rock City Train Tours!

mutant_vehicles.name: Red Hot Beverly -- The Fire "Extinguisher"
mutant_vehicles.description: Red Hot Beverly -- The Fire "Extinguisher" welcomes everyone with dirty beats and giant fire to keep you toasty on chilly nights. Come dance with us or jump on board to roam the playa and see all the amazing art. Eventually, we'll see you at the trash fence!

mutant_vehicles.name: Red Rooster Ranch
mutant_vehicles.description: A playful rendition of the notorious "pleasure palaces and cathouses" that were common in Nevada's gold & silver rush of the late1800's

mutant_vehicles.name: REDEMPTION
mutant_vehicles.description:
We started out with a zero turn Kubota lawnmower and eliminated everything but the drivetrain and motor. 

We named her Redemption because she started out as a lawnmower 20 years ago, slaving away and working hard. She is redeeming herself in a way to be shared amongst all Burners; for those that want to climb in for a picture, simply want to enjoy the ride, or to assist them in getting from one place to another. Redemption will provide a unique experience that our camp and others can enjoy.

mutant_vehicles.name: Regal Eagle
mutant_vehicles.description: Built by artists Garry Sutherland, Shawn Lusebrink, and Rachael Buselmeier. Our majestic and noble art deco eagle, was created using the English wheel technique. The artists are a seasoned team of mutant vehicle builders. They have contributed to the Burning Man experience for decades. The Regal Eagle is a true gift to Black Rock City for 2026.

mutant_vehicles.name: Relaxolotl
mutant_vehicles.description: Looking for a chill way to explore playa? Climb aboard Relaxolotl, where you'll find a cozy place to sit (both because of the cushions and due to its small size ;)), good conversation, a choice of chill tunes, and a slightly faster-than-walking speed to enjoy the city at a slower pace.

mutant_vehicles.name: RetroMan
mutant_vehicles.description: RetroMan is a 9 foot tall 'PacMan' that was inspired by the ghosts that roam the playa. Both of the LED backlit panels are made up of over 7,500 individually controlled LEDs and can do so much more than bring RetroMan to animated life.

mutant_vehicles.name: Rexan
mutant_vehicles.description: Rexan is a safari-themed psychedelic experience on a mission to bring African social traditions and celebration to the playa. This ultimate safari experience takes daring citizens on wildlife tours of BRC, from deep playa to various watering holes. We track CAR-nimals, observe ART-ilopes on ARTery tours, and collect unique MAN-imals for study.

mutant_vehicles.name: Rhino Redemption
mutant_vehicles.description: Rhino Redemption - The baddest Rhino on the Playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Ring Bearer
mutant_vehicles.description: The Ring Bearer with it's glowing gold and gleaming stone brings a message of decommodification and love to all who see this  shining symbol of love and commitment

mutant_vehicles.name: RoboBee
mutant_vehicles.description: Robobee is a robotic bee that pollinates the Playa with love and playful memories.

mutant_vehicles.name: Rocket 'n Roll
mutant_vehicles.description: The Rocket n Roll mutant vehicle is a rocket powered, old time Juke Box designed to bring joy, light and fantastic music to Black Rock City. Catch a ride with us as we explore the deep Playa, dance to the eclectic, surprising music playing on the huge Juke box, bath in the glow of our mirror balls and experience the juicy red lips and tongue that lead the Rocket 'n Roll through dusty adventures every night!

mutant_vehicles.name: Rocket Luna
mutant_vehicles.description: A cartoon rocket ship brought to life in rainbow colored inter-dimensional space

mutant_vehicles.name: RocketCar
mutant_vehicles.description: The Rocket Car is a handmade desert rocket built from salvaged machines and aircraft parts. Its body began as a surplus aircraft drop tank that was reshaped into a narrow aluminum fuselage. Powered by a Honda CX500 motorcycle engine and rolling on rescued MG axles, it looks like a strange experimental rocket cruising the playa. The Rocket Car roams Black Rock City and deep playa offering spontaneous rides and photo moments to curious travelers. By day it looks like a scrap built test vehicle from another era, and by night its glowing lights make it appear like a small wandering rocket exploring the desert.

mutant_vehicles.name: Rocketship
mutant_vehicles.description: It's a starship which warps through time and space.

mutant_vehicles.name: Russell The Love Muscle
mutant_vehicles.description: Russell the Love Muscle is a whole lot of love! Taking your turn on this oversized phallic fella will definitely bring a smile to your face and  put a stir in your loins! He lives out front at Slutt Putt, but you never know where he might pop up on Playa if he needs to scratch an itch!

mutant_vehicles.name: Rusty Palm
mutant_vehicles.description: Tiki Bar with 4 metal palm trees shooting flames

mutant_vehicles.name: SABOKU
mutant_vehicles.description: SABOKU is your friendly furry monster. Warm and bright. We promote slow cruising. No speeding!

mutant_vehicles.name: Salt Cube
mutant_vehicles.description: An interactive exploration of scale and logic, Salt Cube transforms classic toys into a large light installation on wheels. This bright yellow construction toy truck carries a 6-foot LED cube synced to a handheld tactile controller. As participants manipulate the puzzle cube in their hand, the larger-than-life LED cube on the truck responds in real-time, reflecting every twist and turn of the colors. It's a collective childhood memory, amplified for the open playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sasori
mutant_vehicles.description: A mad max desert scorpion, carved from the depths of the galaxy. Fully custom and built from scratch.. battery powered and ready for the playa!

mutant_vehicles.name: Satan's Calliope
mutant_vehicles.description: Satan's Calliope, a fire breathing version of the X-34 land speeder

mutant_vehicles.name: Savage island
mutant_vehicles.description: Massive island with a local bar in the jungle vide

mutant_vehicles.name: Schwangline Stapler
mutant_vehicles.description: Red Schwangline Stapler Dance Machine

mutant_vehicles.name: Scrampi
mutant_vehicles.description:
Scrampi, our Mutant Vehicle for Burning Man, promotes creativity, community, and playfulness, fostering joy and connection among attendees. With its vibrant colors and whimsical nautical decor, it aims to spark conversation and wonder. 

In addition to providing rides, Scrampi will offer refreshing nautical beverages to keep participants hydrated and will play fun nautical-themed music to enhance the experience. 

Aligned with the theme "Axis Mundi," Scrampi encourages attendees to embrace their playful sides and discover the unexpected. More than just transportation, it provides an immersive experience that celebrates art, community, and connection at Burning Man. We look forward to welcoming everyone aboard for a memorable journey!

mutant_vehicles.name: Scrubby
mutant_vehicles.description: Black Rock City's Cleanest Art Car.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sebastian
mutant_vehicles.description: Sebastian is a lovable, vibrantly colorful little fish art car that loves company!

mutant_vehicles.name: Secret Weapon
mutant_vehicles.description: miniature locomotive on a pocket bike

mutant_vehicles.name: Serendeep
