mutant_vehicles.description: Embark on an odyssey across the playa aboard Serendeep, a mystical steampunk carriage - a place where old and new friends join together to journey through the desert sparking wonder, curiosity, and camaraderie.

mutant_vehicles.name: Serenity
mutant_vehicles.description: Serenity started out in the back yard of an antique store. She was a WW2 drop tank that was attached to military planes. She was used to drop flares, paper leaflets with warnings and supplies from her belly. When I found her she was filled with leaves from a few decades ago. I had to have her, I had to give her a new life of gifting to others. She can now give a ride to those in need or a drink to those who are thirsty or she can simply be seen in her beauty as burners stand back and admire her mutated sprit, sole, and transformation. Everything about her had a different life. She is made from salvaged recycled parts, from school chairs to a bone yard of crashed, given up ATV's and speakers covered in dust in a corner of a pawn shop.

mutant_vehicles.name: Serpent Queen
mutant_vehicles.description: The Serpent Queen is a Victorian Steamboat Time Machine Exploration Vessel Designed by Langhorne Industries, under the auspices of the  Nicola Tesla Propulsion Systems Corporation.  The SQ pulls the Jewel Box Theater Stage, this Show Boat Delights passengers and shore-bound lookie-loos with equal fervor, dispalying astounding feats of old world analogue Theatricality coupled with New World accessible digital Banality.  All are welcome on the Journey of Ten Thousand Lifetimes.

mutant_vehicles.name: Shack-To-Hell-U-Ride
mutant_vehicles.description: A mobile miner's "shack" that is right at home in the Black Rock Desert where miners and prospectors still roam.  It looks like a historic miner's shack, a bit mysterious, with untold stories and rituals to divulge or be imagined of days gone by…but with a roof on fire…

mutant_vehicles.name: SharkCar
mutant_vehicles.description: Iconic 72 foot long, 17 foot tall SharkCar with bright red LED rope lighting along the top from head to tail

mutant_vehicles.name: Shenanigan Wagon
mutant_vehicles.description:
"A quaint covered wagon on the outside, and always a party on the inside, the Shenanigan Wagon is where your
shenanigans begin!

mutant_vehicles.name: Shiny
mutant_vehicles.description: Shining

mutant_vehicles.name: ShroomVroom
mutant_vehicles.description:
The ShroomVroom is the motorized stump of a great tree adorned with a giant mushroom - on which a wise hookahsmoking
caterpillar has taken residence. Inspired by "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland" - the classic Lewis Carroll novel.

mutant_vehicles.name: Shutterbuggy
mutant_vehicles.description: The Shutterbuggy is a mobile photo booth modeled after a 1940s camera. You and your friends can get souvenir photos to commemorate your Burning Man experience.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sick Puppy
mutant_vehicles.description: A jet-propelled, junkyard-built, armored gofast car, built from the scraps of a once-decadent society. 0 to 5mph in 2 minutes or less.

mutant_vehicles.name: SIMON the TURTLE
mutant_vehicles.description:
SIMON, our extra-turlestrial friend, is a galactic space-traveling crystal turtle. He's used to being in zero gravity in space, but in BRC, we needed a way for this space-turtle to get around in earth's gravity. The answer: a built-from-scratch remote-controlled electric platform! Keep an eye out for SIMON's shiny geodesic shell and flashy light-up video flippers drifting around the playa and maybe even go for a ride!
samogdenart.com/simontheturtle

mutant_vehicles.name: Single Track
mutant_vehicles.description: Single Track is a desert scooter built from scratch, using a 5hp gasoline engine with a single track rear snowbike type track as well as a four wheeler front end that gives us the ability to brake and steer.

mutant_vehicles.name: SirKiss
mutant_vehicles.description: The SirKiss art car is a double decker circus themed art car where everyone is allowed to join for a ride or a dance party.

mutant_vehicles.name: Slava Oksani Sunflower (SOS)
mutant_vehicles.description: The Slava Oksani Sunflower (SOS) is the yellow fluffy incandescent aquatic wonderland of our dreams. This year MARION JR joins the spectacularity!

mutant_vehicles.name: Sleigher
mutant_vehicles.description: sleigher is here to help you sleigh the night away

mutant_vehicles.name: SM Cascabel
mutant_vehicles.description: Cascabel is a trajinera - the iconic flower-covered gondolas of Xochimilco, Mexico City - reimagined as an electric art car. Built by LaCalaca Village, a camp with over a decade on playa and creators of the Axolotl art car, Cascabel carries the living cultural tradition of Mexico's ancient waterways to the desert. Thirteen feet of hand-painted baroque arch, cushioned lounge seating, and a sound system pointed inward for intimate cruising. Different nights, different names scrawled in chalk on the arch — each voyage a small floating world. Come find us. Hop on. No invitation needed.

mutant_vehicles.name: Smile High
mutant_vehicles.description: An interactive mutant installation practicing radical mutant gifting

mutant_vehicles.name: Snack Attack
mutant_vehicles.description: Armed with a bbq, ready to attack you with snack you didn't even know you wanted

mutant_vehicles.name: Snow Patrol
mutant_vehicles.description: A DEEP-playa après-ski lounge. Snow Patrol is swapping the slopes in the Sierras for the dust in BRC to bring you cabin-cozy vibes, and frosty beats. No lift ticket required—just climb aboard, hop on a chair, and aprés all day and night!🎿❄️

mutant_vehicles.name: Snuggle Shuttle
mutant_vehicles.description: Snuggle Shuttle is a cozy rolling lounge designed to bring comfort and connection to the open playa. With soft seating, warm lighting, and an inviting atmosphere, it offers participants a place to slow down, share stories, and meet new friends while traveling through Black Rock City. More than transportation, Snuggle Shuttle is a mobile gathering space that encourages meaningful conversation, laughter, and presence. Hop aboard, settle in, and enjoy a gentle ride through the dust with good company.

mutant_vehicles.name: Solicorn: A Solar-Powered Owl-Unicorn
mutant_vehicles.description: solicorn = solar + owl + unicorn. We are here to share the beauty and magic of solar power with the people of the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Son of Hal
mutant_vehicles.description: Lazyboy Lounge Chair

mutant_vehicles.name: Soulshakers Photo Serpent
mutant_vehicles.description: Capture the moment on the Playa in our Interactive Photo Bus Serpent Hop in, strike a pose, and let the Soulshakers Photo Serpent  give you a memory to cherish long after you leave the Black Rock City.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sound Bite
mutant_vehicles.description: A glowing, winged angler fish inspired by steampunk and fantasy, featuring vibrant LED panels, immersive sound, and a cozy ride space.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sound Cabin
mutant_vehicles.description: The Sound Cabin was built mainly for DJ to perform with fire playing to their music. It was also built to drive around the Playa and support other big sound art cars performing.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sound Garden
mutant_vehicles.description: Sound Garden is a whimsical and vibrant, lighted grass hill, blooming with flowers, cruising through the day and night, enveloping riders and onlookers in soundscapes and chill beats as they relax in comfort on the fluffy grass.

mutant_vehicles.name: Souper Lounge
mutant_vehicles.description: Welcome to the Souper Lounge—your floating, funky soup bowl on wheels! This art car is a neon-lit, noodle-pillow paradise, complete with veggie plushies, fuzzy carpets, and a whole lotta cozy vibes. We're serving up hot broths and soups straight from the back to keep you warm or cool (depending on how much fun you're having). Hop in, chill out, and let's get saucy! The Souper Lounge is your new favorite hangout, where soup, silliness, and community come together in the most deliciously ridiculous way. We will have intimate DJ sets, open mic nights, sound healings and more as we cruise around the playa! Come for the broth, stay for the friends—and maybe a veggie plushie or two!

mutant_vehicles.name: Space Shuttle
mutant_vehicles.description: Rock it ! Man Is a unique space shuttle that cruises Playa sharing laughs and wifi.

mutant_vehicles.name: SpaceGrab
mutant_vehicles.description:
The inspiration for SpaceGrab was a small black stuffed alien I thrifted in 1996 as a gift to my son. Years passed, and before leaving for college he gifted it back to me because, "Mom, this little guy was meant to stay with you." A couple years later SpaceGrab was born! Debuting on playa in 2010, his whimsical presence has been my annual pleasure to share with our playa family. 
     SpaceGrab can't wait to make it back to the dust again to share his expression of love and acceptance of all humans. It's his favorite time of year! If you see us on playa, come give the alien a hug, literally, he is a giant stuffed animal!

mutant_vehicles.name: Spark the Firefly
mutant_vehicles.description: Spark is a giant firefly brought to life on the playa, with a sculpted head, illuminated wings, and a glowing segmented abdomen that doubles as a cozy mobile lounge. At night, it pulses with warm light that echoes the rhythm of a real firefly, becoming a soft beacon in the desert. Designed for connection and shared experience, Spark offers a welcoming space for riders of all ages to gather, rest, and take in Black Rock City from a new perspective as it drifts gently through the night.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sparkle Pony Xpress
mutant_vehicles.description: The Sparkle Pony Express is ready to provide rides and ice cold water to veteran burners and sparkle ponies alike!

mutant_vehicles.name: Sparkle Trike
mutant_vehicles.description: Sparkle Trike is an alien biker creation designed to look like a disembodied glowing head float across the playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Sparky McFly
mutant_vehicles.description: Sparky McFly: A small rocketship powered by the sun

mutant_vehicles.name: Sparky the Star Trek Shuttlecraft
mutant_vehicles.description: its a ford aerostar van taken down to its floorboards and rebuilt as a shuttlecraft from startek

mutant_vehicles.name: Sphere Car
mutant_vehicles.description: This rolling dance floor is a party on 3 wheels! Lights, music and multiple observations decks. We will be rolling across the play at an unhurried pace gathering up participants as we go. Not to brag but there's even a sink with soap and running water to wash your filthy putrid hands at.

mutant_vehicles.name: Spokes
mutant_vehicles.description:
Spokes started out with the chassis made from all bent tubing from scratch. 

His unique wheels are made from 40" sewer pipe as well as his single rear wheel from a 56" pipe. The rear wheel is also the steering mechanism for the whole vehicle, similar to a forklift.  

It started out as a pedal car over ten years ago at burning man, and is now powered by a 7.5 hp motor

mutant_vehicles.name: SS Mezcal
mutant_vehicles.description: SS Mezcal is a solar powered electric mutant vehicle styled as a fractured mezcal barrel from the future. The SS stands for spaceship, a tongue in cheek nod to a craft that cruises the dust instead of the space. Built as a moving gift rather than a private party, it rolls up to create quick moments with strangers: a toast, a short dance, a tiny ritual, or a good story. The crew actively hosts and keeps it welcoming. Spot us on playa, flag us down and jump aboard!

mutant_vehicles.name: SS TaTa
mutant_vehicles.description: Pink boob submarine built for breast cancer awareness and support

mutant_vehicles.name: Stargazer
mutant_vehicles.description: 40ft labyrinth triple level dragon LED bus wth fire effects

mutant_vehicles.name: Starship Qubit
mutant_vehicles.description: The Overview Effect is in effect! Program the hyperdrive and explore the solar system. Come see the Earth and the stars and many things beyond. Aliens are welcome!

mutant_vehicles.name: Steampunk Weighted Companion Cube
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Aperture Science Enrichment Center reminds you that the Weighted Companion Cube will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot speak. However, any advice it does give you should be radically included.

The Weighted Companion Cubes are from the computer game "Portal"; this year there will be two, one companion cube and one steampunk cube. They are single rider, mobile art pieces, a 3 foot square cube, with sound and lights.

Remember, the cake is a lie!

mutant_vehicles.name: Storytime
mutant_vehicles.description: Storytime is a larger-than-life Tiffany's banker's lamp and library, building community through the magic of storytelling and reading aloud across the playa. Pick up a book, sit in a circle, and read to friends new and old. Lie back, listen, and watch the stained-glass lampshade slowly change overhead. Share your own stories, or create a new one together. Storytime is a stage for telling, sharing and connection, and a comfortable retreat from the noise, throughout the city and in deep playa

mutant_vehicles.name: SubLime
mutant_vehicles.description: Ready for a truly Sublime experience? Catch a ride on our glowing yellow submarine!

mutant_vehicles.name: Suck
mutant_vehicles.description: Suck the vacuum cleaner

mutant_vehicles.name: SUPERFLY
mutant_vehicles.description: The SUPERFLY is a 65' long house fly, an assemblage of reclaimed carhoods, blind spot mirrors and crumbled window screen, all brought together for the inclusive transit service of BRC

mutant_vehicles.name: SuperMod-PediQuad / Pakeyu's Solar Car
mutant_vehicles.description:
the SMPQ is a fully solar powered / electric assisted taxi originally designed as an abstract octopus with flowing tentacles that are now covered in flowers & vines allowing the passengers to be transported through an environment of nature.

The SMPQ ultimately offers a unique silent floating experience as a passenger within, and as a visual spectacle to passerbyers from afar. it runs ALL day long powered by the sun alone, and stores enough energy in the modified battery array to continue all through the night... shuffling strangers to centercamp, a party deep deep playa, the infirmary, home or to find safety with a friend... 

always going to & form every corner of the playa. we have met many a new friend as a result!!!

mutant_vehicles.name: Sweet Car Bed
mutant_vehicles.description: Sweet Car Bed, by Andy Henry.

mutant_vehicles.name: Sweet Ride (was Candy Cart)
mutant_vehicles.description: The Candy Cart brings much needed calories to burners on the playa and beyond. Look for the gummy bears and stop by for some candy!

mutant_vehicles.name: Taking Back The Tea Party
mutant_vehicles.description: The Tea Party, Cheshire Cat and Caterpillar from Alice in Wonderland

mutant_vehicles.name: Tauntaun
mutant_vehicles.description: A floating Tauntaun travels across the desert carrying a crusty burner.  Whom tamed whom?

mutant_vehicles.name: TEST Hilary's MV 2026 #1
mutant_vehicles.description: Avoid using special characters and symbols or URL links.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Beaver Ranch Down Under
mutant_vehicles.description: The Beaver Ranch Down Under, is an old Victorian themed brothel. Run by Kiwi's. It is a people mover that has been modified into an old fashioned building to provide an old world theme to the oldest profession in the world.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Big Cheese
mutant_vehicles.description: Bringing nostalgia, warmth and cheesy puns to the playa, The Big Cheese is a unique ride.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Bioluminescent Slug
mutant_vehicles.description: Part creature, part vessel, the Bioluminescent Slug drifts across the Playa like something dreamed up at the bottom of a glowing sea. Its enormous eye scans the darkness, its segmented body pulses with blue and violet light, and its open deck carries a lucky few on slow, luminous journeys through Black Rock City. Equal parts art installation and living invitation — when the Slug rolls past, you stop and stare. When it stops for you, you climb aboard.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Boob Tube
mutant_vehicles.description: What does every burner in the history of all burners miss the most while on the playa? Television, of course! So... Ladies and germs, freaks, hippies, yuppies, ravers, tech-bros, evil billionaires and everything in-between, the whole spectrum of burnery burnerness -- may we present to you The Boob Tube, Black Rock City's custom-built drivable TV -- bringing joy, merriment, and quality fun-casting to the playa since 2013!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Bounce Car
mutant_vehicles.description: Party Machine spreading Bouncy vibes all over the Playa...

mutant_vehicles.name: The BRC Municipal Railway
mutant_vehicles.description: BRC's own San Francisco Cable Car, outfitted in style by and for BRC citizens.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Bull
mutant_vehicles.description: The Bull!  Cattle were once used to help transport settlers across this once desolate trail and not much has changed today,  The Bull is still transporting Burners Far and wide through the Black Rock City. Listen for the cows MOEWING on the Playa!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Buoy
mutant_vehicles.description: Come drift the playa on a ocean buoy setting sail each day on playa.  Take a ride and give the buoy a spin whirling around as desired to get the most panoramic view of the playa

mutant_vehicles.name: The Canoe
mutant_vehicles.description: the canoe an enjoyable ride on playa

mutant_vehicles.name: The Chiton Pickup Car
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Chiton Pickup Car by Doty and the Pickup Car Crew
The Chiton Chapel project companion vehicle for the friends of the Chiton Chapel to spread the love to the Burning Man community at large.
Sonoma County, Californiaedacted@example.invalid

mutant_vehicles.name: The Cloud
mutant_vehicles.description: The Cloud is a group project by a bunch of crazy tree people who like bright music and loud lights :)-

mutant_vehicles.name: The Cuttlefish
mutant_vehicles.description: The Cuttlefish ( formerly known as Sepia Lux) is the only known animatronic, inflatable cuttlefish. Lit with thousands of LED's and equipped with big sound.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Dancing Peacock
mutant_vehicles.description: The Dancing Peacock spreading love, and offering rides to all on the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Dirty Sardine
mutant_vehicles.description: The Dirty Sardine is a mutant vehicle designed to look like an open sardine can with a purpose to pack in and meet fellow burners on the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Disco Ball
mutant_vehicles.description: An amazing, shiny Disco Ball art car spreading love, music and fun one ride at a time.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Dusty Fantasy
mutant_vehicles.description: Introducing the Dusty Fantasia Artcar - a captivating fusion of retro nostalgia and innovative design, crafted to immerse you in a 70's summer beach club experience like never before. Picture yourself cruising the playa, surrounded by the sounds of funky beats, tantalizing refreshments, and cool treats, all aboard a unique vessel that promises an unforgettable journey. As you follow the boat on its drives, you'll find yourself drawn into a world of good music, engaging conversation, and water, providing the perfect respite from the desert heat.  venture out into the deep playa and join us for dance parties under the stars.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Eclipse
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Eclipse is inspired by cosmic events like eclipses and alignments, capturing the firmament's beauty with planets, stars, and moons. Built on a two-story truck, celebrates the universe's wonder.
The first floor has an enclosed lounge with LED-projected stars on walls and ceiling, immersing guests in a night sky. The second floor, accessed by reinforced ladders and surrounded by rails, offers a lounge with comfy seats and a perforated canopy for sun and wind.
Two Wheels of Fortune adorn its sides: one lunar-themed, gifting based on moon phases, and one planetary, offering pranks or treats. Gold filigree panels of the Sun, Moon, and planets decorate the exterior. The cabin and tires, covered yet visible, feature planetary designs.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Electric Wrecker
mutant_vehicles.description: A Burning Man classic! An electric robotic horseless carriage, roaming the playa since 2008. Our vehicles are all electric, meant to inspire others to build their own electric vehicles.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Frog Prince
mutant_vehicles.description: The Frog Prince is a giant frog with a golden crown and kissable purple lips. Rock out with your friends on 2 decks. Leave only frog prints behind.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Fuckin' Arrr!
mutant_vehicles.description: Rustic Pirate Ship

mutant_vehicles.name: The Galactic Terrapin
mutant_vehicles.description: The Galactic Terrapin, aka “Bustachio”, is our beloved sea turtle. Based on a 1987 Ford 460 bus, he hosts a dj booth and dance floor atop his 30-person deck. The Galactic Terrapin glides across the playa aiming to take you on your next intergalactic adventure of epic proportions. Rear-end entry only, please.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Galaxki
mutant_vehicles.description: Small but adventurous, the G-laxki travels far from her mothership Echolalia to collect curious beings and bring them home to Echolalia, where adventure and connections await

mutant_vehicles.name: The Gayatri Shanti
mutant_vehicles.description: The Gayatri Shanti - a manifestation portal vehicle that will help to facilitate the transmutation of one's intentions , manifestations, and desire to release

mutant_vehicles.name: The Geode
mutant_vehicles.description: A cracked-open amethyst geode rolling across the playa. Rough and rocky on the outside, glowing purple within. Crystal spires of varying heights surround the driver, lit from within at night. Come find the light inside the rock.

mutant_vehicles.name: The GiantCockCar
mutant_vehicles.description: The Playa's biggest COCK (car) - since 2009! The GiantCockCar is a 22 foot tall Peacock riding two rockets.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Golden Calf
mutant_vehicles.description: A quiet space for meditation, reflection, and contemplation during the day, a party with music, dancing, flames, and entertainment with a unique light-hearted sacrilegious twist at night.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Great Sammich Ride
mutant_vehicles.description:
Are you hungry? I'm your hot cinnamon-butter joy injection.
Actually, I'm a giant, squishy peanut butter and jelly Sammich with wings. You can eat me! You can dance with me! You can hitch a ride on my cushy peanut-butter wings!
I'm here to deliver joy on the playa by serving hot 'n toasty cinnamon-butter grilled, gluten-free gourmet PB&J's.
Look for my rotating "Sammiches" marquee sign and hop on board for a loungy ride around the ol' dust bowl at exactly Whenever O'clock.  And if you really want fun, join my Sammich crew in serving up hot toasty delights to other hungry burners today.
Because as my Grandma Sammich once told me:
"There's no holier act than helping others get the goody out of life."
Come play!
- The Great Sammich Ride

mutant_vehicles.name: The Hush Hush Pony Barn
mutant_vehicles.description: Hush Hush

mutant_vehicles.name: The Intergalactic Transporter
mutant_vehicles.description: Hop on the IGT for transportation to the next galaxy!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Jolly Trolley
mutant_vehicles.description: We're a happy little trolley wanting to meet new friends and offer rides! We may be small out on the playa but don't let that fool you - we have BIG hearts !

mutant_vehicles.name: The Last Giant Otter
mutant_vehicles.description: Meet *Cuddles the Otter*, a floating, illuminated pod of otters rolling across the playa on the belly of the mother otter. Wrapped in fur, light, music, and mischief, Cuddles invites dusty wanderers to climb aboard, stay connected, and drift together through the currents of Black Rock City.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Lighthouse
mutant_vehicles.description: The Lighthouse is a beacon to weary burners, entertaining with music and lights at night and serving Cuban coffee at sunrise.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Lonely Reef
mutant_vehicles.description: Surfacing from the sunken depths of the dusty sea, The Lonely Reef is an ecosystem that hosts a dreamlike bungalow oasis.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Lookout
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Chakora bird sits every night gazing at the indifference of the moon. He is in deep, enduring love with her, and has dedicated his life to her beauty. He bathes in her moon light, sits patiently without regret, and captures her moonbeams in his feathers. After a long night, he goes home to his small laboratory, The Lookout, and gently sifts through all the moonbeams. He puts them in bottles and sends them out into the world.

A tiny wooden house, with stained glass windows and hidden secret messages will be pushed around by mosaic clouds and a mosaic moon. This is the laboratory of the Charkora, and is meant for people to sit with the moon beams and feel the universal language of complete love.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Love Beacon
mutant_vehicles.description: We're the smallest, tallest, carbon neutral MV at Burning Man

mutant_vehicles.name: The Love Bunny
mutant_vehicles.description: Love Bunny celebrates the metamorphosis that comes with the dawn's renewed light; Love Bunny is famous for delivering sustenance in the early hours of the morning and rescuing Burners from long haul walks across the Playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Magic Flying Carpet
mutant_vehicles.description: The O.G. flying carpet

mutant_vehicles.name: The Metro Chop
mutant_vehicles.description: An Art Car for the people.  Where everyone is VIP and we aim to save the world one burner at a time.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Millennium  Falcon
mutant_vehicles.description: Han's iconic smuggling ship, The Millennium Falcon lives on.  Reimagined on a Nascar Frame wrapped in steel.  Built to scale and powered by a Second Gen Chevy v-8 small block it is still one of the fastest hunks of junk in the Galaxy.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Monkey
mutant_vehicles.description: The Monkey was created for cruises on the playa, easy accessibility for all burners to jump on and enjoy the art and beauty that Burning Man provides each year.

mutant_vehicles.name: the Mushroom Patch
mutant_vehicles.description: The Mushroom Patch is a fanciful transport for the citizens of BRC. Five giant mushrooms sprout out of a colorful plush platform which is accessible from all directions. The mushrooms provide shade during the day and glow with brilliantly changing lights at night.

mutant_vehicles.name: THE MUTANT JETSKI
mutant_vehicles.description: THE MUTANT JETSKI is a vintage watercraft reborn for the desert, transformed into a moving piece of interactive art. Mounted on a modified ATV chassis and powered by a 420cc engine, it preserves its original colors while evolving into something unexpected. By day, it appears as a familiar object out of place, inviting curiosity and play. By night, it comes alive with immersive LED lighting, glowing as it moves across the playa. Blending mechanical ingenuity with creative reuse, it offers participants a surreal experience where water meets dust and imagination takes over.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Nudibranch
mutant_vehicles.description: The Nudibranch  is a 25-foot bus converted to a large nudibranch (underwater sea slug) that serves as a mobile event space, sound stage, dance platform on top of the bus, and an aquarium themed lounge area inside the bus, all inspired by the beauty and uniqueness of the Nudibranch – hypnotically beautiful underwater sea slugs found across the world.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Pegasus: Celestial Chariot
mutant_vehicles.description: The Pegasus, a celestial chariot that will regally transport you through the playa, the galaxy, the heavens and all the way back.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Perambulator
mutant_vehicles.description: The Perambulator is a splendid steampunk airship with seating for 8 passengers and a rear cargo deck for wheelchairs/mobility scooters.

mutant_vehicles.name: The PUGG
mutant_vehicles.description: The PUGG...much more than just a practical uplifting galactic gadget.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Purple Pearl
mutant_vehicles.description: The Purple Pearl is a giant sea clam that holds six passengers as she galivants across the Playa. She is white in the daytime but has a technicolor nighttime glow that brings joy to all creatures in Black Rock City. She is more than just a mode of transportation but an epic travelling sea creature to be viewed near and far.

mutant_vehicles.name: the red eyed rabbit
mutant_vehicles.description: the red eyed rabbit is a capricious lil dust devil cruising the playa dust waves. be sure to give and wave and a smile. feel free to as for a ride she loves company

mutant_vehicles.name: The Scarab Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: Scarab is a fusion of metal, speakers, engine, and fabric, designed to create unforgettable moments of connection and energy.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Skiff by The Western Boys
mutant_vehicles.description: The Skiff is a serene, retro-futuristic craft-inspired electric mutant vehicle designed to ferry curious souls across the playa. With no sound system and seating for up to 12 passengers, it invites meaningful conversation, shared wonder, and quiet exploration. Beneath its handcrafted benches lies a hidden cooler stocked with ice-cold drinks, gifted generously along the journey. Glowing softly at night with elegant ambient lighting, The Skiff is a floating sanctuary; offering presence over performance and meaningful connection over chaos.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Spynx
mutant_vehicles.description: The Spynx of the Playa art car operated beside the Anubis art car with a crew of Egyptian inhabitants.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Struggle Bus
mutant_vehicles.description: A fusion of train, submarine, and bus, The Struggle Bus is a steampunk spectacle on wheels, rolling through Black Rock City with a mission to help, transport, and entertain. Clad in decorative metal, porthole windows, and a fire-shooting smokestack, it's equal parts mutant vehicle and mobile adventure. By day, it hosts playful art tours with witty banter, and by night, it transforms into a Cyberpunk light show, streaking across the playa with flowing LED trails, and bursts of flame.  Whether offering a ride, a laugh, or a much-needed assist, The Struggle Bus ensures that no burner struggles alone!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Surly Bird
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Surly Bird is the double decker art car of Surly Camp. She first debuted on the playa in 2003 and has undergone some amazing and imaginative transformations since then. As the DMV and Burning Man community are demanding higher quality art and ingenuity, the crew of Surly Camp rises to the occasion, offering the eyes new and inspiring imagery. 2012 brought forth the Surly Phoenix, with laser eyes and feathers galore. Lots of hard work went into this baby, and the DMV seemed happy enough... 

The crew of Surly Camp steps up each year in a big way to give the old girl a fresh coat of love. They drive and fly in from all over the states to help out in the months before Burning Man. They do it out of love. They do it for you.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Taco Disco
mutant_vehicles.description: The Taco Disco is a fanciful art car in the shape of a giant crispy taco. Imagine seeing the taco of your munchy dreams floating across the playa dispensing tacos and great tunes whenever it is stopped, bringing joy to all.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Tea Kettle
mutant_vehicles.description: a vibrant tea kettle and tea cup with 360 viewing, offering water and shade to all!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Ticket Booth
mutant_vehicles.description: Get your free drink tickets at the Official Drink Ticket Booth. A drivable ticket booth that transforms from a carnival style ticket booth into a full on DJ booth equipped with pro sound and video.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Underneath
mutant_vehicles.description: The Underneath is a glowing decomposer-on-wheels, where personal and planetary composting become one regenerative act.

mutant_vehicles.name: The Universe in a Nutshell
mutant_vehicles.description: The Universe in a Nutshell, a half walnut shell art car containing a part of the universe, which wanders around the greater universe that is Burning Man.

mutant_vehicles.name: the vrill society flying saucer
mutant_vehicles.description: our vehicle is a whimsical , stunning , and magical piece of art that stirs the imagination and provokes thought and fun wherever  she goes

mutant_vehicles.name: The Wandering Playhouse
mutant_vehicles.description: A moving playground that encourages interactivity and playful nature by allowing users to enjoy dancing, swinging, riding, sliding, and relaxing on The Wandering Playhouse!

mutant_vehicles.name: The Wonder Wagon
mutant_vehicles.description: Electric vehicle stagecoach propelled by 10 wonder ponies.

mutant_vehicles.name: The ZoomBox
mutant_vehicles.description: A rad, larger than life-size boom box for your very own playa pop up dance party.

mutant_vehicles.name: Third Eye Scream
mutant_vehicles.description: The iconic Third Eye Scream is play on the Illuminati, and a symbol of enlightenment.  You can find it parked somewhere gifting ice cream or floating on the horizon playing mystical tunes in Deep Playa at night.

mutant_vehicles.name: This Is Fine
mutant_vehicles.description: The world might be a rolling dumpster fire in the desert, but according to ancient wisdom that's also where the strongest steel is forged. Remember, just because you’re trash doesn’t mean you can’t do great things. It’s called garbage can, not garbage cannot!

mutant_vehicles.name: Thong patrol
mutant_vehicles.description:
The thong patrol!
A multi-purpose art car designed to look like a flip flop and feel like your at the beach. A 100% electric art car designed to make a small footprint on a big beach. A functional art car/service vehicle loaded with tools to fix anything anywhere!

mutant_vehicles.name: Thor
mutant_vehicles.description: Hailing from Denver, CO, Thor is built on a 29' city bus frame to look like the Norse deity Thor flying across the playa. Thor is adorned with a cape-shaded top deck and a massive sheet metal helmet and face, with Jormungandr, a giant LED-backlit sea serpent along one side and custom sound with lightning bolts and a massive LED display panel on the other. Come say hi and grab a ride when you see us roaming the playa!

mutant_vehicles.name: Thor-Viking Ship
mutant_vehicles.description: Thor-Viking Ship created by Dennis Alumbaugh.  Lighting by Randy Frasier, both of Reno NV.  The car is maintained by members of camp Brand-Ur-Ass n more.

mutant_vehicles.name: Throwin Shade
mutant_vehicles.description: "Throwing Shade" is the grooviest little big lamp shade on playa

mutant_vehicles.name: Tikivision
mutant_vehicles.description:
TikiVision is a Large Mobile Retro Television-Shaped Vehicle and Interactive Media Lounge, providing entertainment,
comfort, tours, and services for denizens of Black Rock City.

mutant_vehicles.name: Time Bandit!
mutant_vehicles.description: Junkyard, Steampunk Time Machine. Bending space-time & playa while bumpin' popup dance parties at the portos since 2016.

mutant_vehicles.name: TMSL MINI ME MIGHTYZENITH ART ATTACK CLASS MODEL 2025 MARK I
mutant_vehicles.description: We are an electric mobile performance stage with a show of Playa All Stars that masquerades as a 1960 Zenith TeeVee Set that lumbers about the Playa - we aim to be the Happiest Talk Show On Earth, where YOU BE THE CONTENT

mutant_vehicles.name: Toastcar
mutant_vehicles.description: The Toastcar is a tiny electric toaster car built to bring magic into our everyday lives.

mutant_vehicles.name: Torch the Dragon
mutant_vehicles.description:
We are grateful to share our fire breathing dragon with you and we invite everyone to come aboard for a ride and encourage you to hit THE BUTTON and take control of the flame effects. Our biggest joy in owning this amazing art car is watching your faces light up (literally) with joy partying with Torch. 

Torch isn't just a mutant vehicle, he's an interactive experience and memory making machine!

mutant_vehicles.name: TOWER69
mutant_vehicles.description: TOWER69 is a mobile lifeguard tower transformed into an interactive art vehicle. Inspired by the iconic lifeguard towers of the California coast. The structure becomes a playful lookout, gathering point, and moving stage  across the desert. By day it offers shade and views, and by night it glows with lighting and music, creating a welcoming space for connection, exploration, and spontaneous moments on the playa.

mutant_vehicles.name: Tracks
mutant_vehicles.description:
I started out with a two older snowblowers, eliminated everything but one of the motors, and replaced the drivetrain and reoriented the motor to accommodate a new, customer drive linkage assembly.

I named her Tracks because she started out as two old snowblowers having tank track style wheels, slaving away and working hard. Now those tracks have been repurposed to be shared among all Burners and the Burning Man community, for those that want to climb on for a ride or a picture. Tracks will provide a unique experience that our camp and others can enjoy.

mutant_vehicles.name: TransMission
mutant_vehicles.description: Metal Mimi Camp's mutant vehicle, which is lovingly named TransMission, carries history and a long legacy forward. TransMission was created in memory of the beloved Tom Kennedy. His enduring impact is brought forward here. Many decades ago, Tom was one of Burning Man's original mutant vehicle artists. TransMission has been resurrected and recreated by San Francisco's metal artists Haideen Andersen, Dana Albany and Flash.

mutant_vehicles.name: TRION
mutant_vehicles.description:
A moving temple of light and sound, based on sacred geometry and designed as a musical stage. At its core is the triangle — the fundamental form of the structure and a central symbol in sacred geometry, representing balance, ascension, and connection.

It creates an immersive experience through music, light, and collective energy, bringing people together and uniting them through sound in a shared moment in the desert.

Blending ancient symbolic ideas with modern technology, it becomes more than an art car — a luminous triangular form moving through the night, creating moments of energy, connection, and collective experience.

mutant_vehicles.name: Tuatara
mutant_vehicles.description: Tuatara are reptiles endemic to New Zealand. Although resembling most lizards, they are more dinosaur than lizard. Their name derives from the Māori language, and means "peaks on the back"

mutant_vehicles.name: UFoART CART
mutant_vehicles.description:
The UFoART CART is taking specimens material data of the peculiarities and oddities located at 40° 47' 13.1352'' N 119° 12' 14.688'' W,
Earth, Solar System, Orion Arm, Milky Way, Local Group, Virgo Supercluster, Laniakea Supercluster, and Universe.

There have been reports of anomalous behaviors in the mammalian sub-groups. 

Investigations underway.

mutant_vehicles.name: USS Nevada
mutant_vehicles.description: USS Nevada is the oldest pirate ship on the Playa, bringing pirate joy and mischief all over the Playa!

mutant_vehicles.name: Uuna Ahi
mutant_vehicles.description: A giant metal fire shooting Moai

mutant_vehicles.name: Vessel of Love
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Vessel of Love is a glowing mobile lounge designed to spread connection and joy across the playa. 
Built from a mutated electric golf buggy, it features a cozy cuddle puddle for passengers to relax together and a small viewing deck above for taking in the magic of Black Rock City. 
Inspired by our Vessels of Love art installation and its infinity heart theme, the vehicle travels the playa sharing warmth, music, and spontaneous moments of togetherness. With vibrant LED lighting and a welcoming atmosphere, the Vessel of Love invites burners to pause, connect, and experience a little more love on the journey.

mutant_vehicles.name: vibeapple
mutant_vehicles.description: The Vibiest Pineapple on earth

mutant_vehicles.name: Vigorous Spirit
mutant_vehicles.description: Vigorous Spirit is a large-scale mutant vehicle inspired by Eastern mythology and imagined mythical creatures. Built on a Ford F-150 truck chassis, it has been transformed with a welded steel frame, sculptural bodywork, illuminated scales, glowing eyes, and a bright tail design. At night, LED lighting and spotlights bring the creature to life across the playa. The project combines visual impact, ambient sound, and mobile interaction to create a calm, welcoming, and immersive art experience for the Burning Man community.

mutant_vehicles.name: Vroom Vroom
mutant_vehicles.description: Vroom Vroom is a giant Roller Skate that's a tribute and homage to roller skaters around the world. I've been skating for 14 years and love the community of skaters I've met.

mutant_vehicles.name: Wanda
mutant_vehicles.description: Known as Wanda, this mutant vehicle wonderful highly articulated creation of the rarely seen deep sea creature known as Angler Fish. Day or night, the vehicle is highly visible and easily recognizable as same to those who have seen pictures of this illusive creature.

mutant_vehicles.name: WarPony
mutant_vehicles.description:
An open air 1974 Chevy Blazer with a wooden roof is EXACTLY what we need for our Thunderdome fleet. She's got ridiculous light bars up, down, and sideways. Maybe we'll add some whimsy... like a tire swing - we
haven't had one of those in ... quite some time. WarPony has ample seating for all the folks we can cram on her, and a
little bit more seating on top of that. Please. Please don't sit on the hood. Otherwise, you can scramble all around her
and. Well. Tetanus is at your own risk. She's tall and fun!

mutant_vehicles.name: Wet Dream
mutant_vehicles.description:
The Wet Dream was previously sea worthy vessel, now transformed into a playa vessel by mutating a fiber glass 1957 Dorset power boat with a 1969 VW Beatle. From interior and exterior, what is left from the VW beetle is not visible-visually is floating on the playa.
The Wet Dream has LED lighting. Blue for water effect around the bottom of the boat, mutable colors around the deck and mass, and red on staircase and hand rails. On top of the mass 18' off the playa is a crows nest with a multi colored LED party light sending out a 150' array of illumination down to the sea around the Wet Dream. Cabin ceiling, black light illuminating a hand painted night sky. There are lantern's and other spontaneous lighting affects as well )'(

mutant_vehicles.name: What's Up Dock
mutant_vehicles.description: What's Up Dock is a southern bayou themed fishing shack and dock.  Join us for a lazy ride winding our way through the streets of Black Rock City and seek adventure on the open playa.  Together we'll reminisce of past burns and tell stories about the one that got away.  And if it breaks down... we'll even let you help push it back to camp!

mutant_vehicles.name: Whipple 3
mutant_vehicles.description: The Calico Dragon is one of the most approachable cars on playa.  With long couches lining both sides of the vehicle and a single step up to sit down makes this vehicle less intimidating for burners to hop on and enjoy the ride.

mutant_vehicles.name: Whiskers
mutant_vehicles.description: A purrfectly playful rideable cat!

mutant_vehicles.name: X-34 Landspeeder
mutant_vehicles.description: The X-34 Landspeeder is an open-air cockpit speeder powered a repulsorlift engine and three air-cooled thrust turbines. It hovers three feet off the ground and is ideal transportation for open desert environments. This model is bright red and gold and can be found most days at Black Rock City in the Mos Eisley Spaceport camp.

mutant_vehicles.name: XS Baggage
mutant_vehicles.description: An exploration of baggage, both physical and emotional, and their place in each individual's personal journey. With a blend of whimsey and nostalgia, XS Baggage invites inspection and introspection. A visual representation of the C.S. Lewis quote,"It's not he load that breaks you down, it's how you carry it."

mutant_vehicles.name: XUZA
mutant_vehicles.description:
Step into the surreal world of XUZA, a fully mutated two-level art car that has been prowling Black Rock City since 2014. Forged in Las Vegas, NV, XUZA is a spectacle of light, sound, and fire, blending futuristic technology with radical creativity.

With hypnotic CGI-driven eyes, pulsating LED tentacles, a pixel-mapped LED ceiling, and dynamic fire effects, XUZA is more than a vehicle—it's an immersive journey into the unknown. Flames erupt in sync with the music as XUZA prowls through the dust or ignites the night at art burns and The Man.

Whether cruising or stationed at an event, XUZA invites all to step aboard, connect, and experience a world where sound, fire, and motion merge into a shared adventure.

mutant_vehicles.name: Y Knot Saloon
mutant_vehicles.description: Y Knot Saloon is a one of a kind two-story western bar designed, engineered and built by Keith London and the teams of Sean Orlando and Dave Keane.

mutant_vehicles.name: Yaba Daba Do Me
mutant_vehicles.description: A bitchin' two story Flintstone mobile

mutant_vehicles.name: Zenith
mutant_vehicles.description:
Zenith is a desert yacht built for the journey as much as the destination. Cruise and settle in — we’re here to roam the Playa, stumble into magic, and pull up to wherever the night takes us.
Every design element on Zenith reaches upward, a visual nod to the name itself: zenith, meaning pinnacle — and tracing back further, peak experience. That’s the intention. Not just a ride, but a moment.
If you spot us rolling between sunset and sunrise, flag us down. We love meeting new people, and we usually have water or snacks if you need to replenish. Come say hi — the higher path is always better shared.

mutant_vehicles.name: Zeong
mutant_vehicles.description: "Witness the awe-inspiring Pui, evolved from a loyal sidekick into a colossal Gundam mech, dominating the Playa with style! Clad in shimmering armor, its thrusters roar like a desert storm, leaving trails of stardust in its wake. Armed with laser precision and an adorable battle stance, this mech-master patrols the wild sands, a perfect blend of cuddly charm and unstoppable might—ready to protect the Playa from any intergalactic mischief!"

mutant_vehicles.name: Ziggy Star Duster
mutant_vehicles.description: Ziggy Starduster is a retro desert speeder inspired by the classic sci fi vehicles many of us remember from childhood. It started life as a small convertible and was rebuilt with a custom welded frame and aluminum body panels to create a low floating landspeeder style vehicle. The glowing rear engines and ground lighting give it the feeling that it is hovering just above the playa at night. During the day it rolls across the dust like something from another world. Our goal is simple, bring a little desert sci fi imagination to Black Rock City and share rides and good vibes with fellow burners along the way.

mutant_vehicles.name: Zulai Art Car
mutant_vehicles.description: Zulai (Tathāgata) is a hand-woven bamboo art car shaped like a giant open palm, carrying a serene Buddha figure at one end. Designed to evoke calmness and security, it glides across the playa as a moving sanctuary. At night, Zulai glows from within, transforming into a luminous beacon of peace.

mutant_vehicles.name: ZZYZXT
mutant_vehicles.description: Steam punk Inspired/Great Dane Inspired unique one of a kind vehicle.
